entries.source: An ancient evil from days long gone. He seeks to reshape the world according to his design--one in which his decision is law and freedom loses all meaning.
entries.target: 他试图根据自己的设计重新塑造世界,一个他的决定是法律,自由失去了一切意义.

entries.source: The legendary wizard who sealed away Lord Xankulos. The world thought he had died, though he'd actually just been dragged inside his own sealing chest.
entries.target: 传奇的巫师封闭了库洛斯爵士,世界认为他死了,

entries.source: Constantly in fear of falling objects, whether it be bird poop or this very orb. . . ! Ironically, they've never actually been hit by anything.
entries.target: 很奇怪的是,它们从来没有被任何东西撞到.

entries.source: Keen on keeping Canopy Town the way it is and always has been, even if things have already changed without him noticing.
entries.target: 他一直坚持保持城的状态,即使事情已经改变了,

entries.source: She loves baking pastries. So much so that she creates an entirely new recipe every single day. Never mind that she couldn't replicate any if she tried.
entries.target: 她喜欢做糕点,所以每天都会创造一个全新的食谱.

entries.source: Always too eager to prove his maturity, Jack eventually learns that he still doesn't quite hit the mark--that is, until he discovers something ELSE exciting.
entries.target: 他一直很渴望证明自己的成熟,杰克最终发现他仍然不完全达到标志--即,直到他发现了另一个令人兴奋的事情.

entries.source: Loves to climb the trees of Canopy Town as part of his morning exercise routine. For some residents above, his rustling about is their alarm clock.
entries.target: 他喜欢把攀爬树冠镇的大树当作晨练。对一些住在高处的居民来说，他折腾树枝的动静就是闹钟。

entries.source: Lately has been on a mission to tell others about his home under the sea, in hopes of attracting new residents. Not many seem interested.
entries.target: 现在,他正在向别人讲述他海底的家,希望吸引新居民.

entries.source: Worries about her son, Taku, who always hides away in his room. She can go weeks without seeing him at all.
entries.target: 她担心她的儿子塔库,他总是躲在他的房间里.

entries.source: Obsessed with cartoon characters, particularly his @waifu,@ Ayumi-chan, from @Pretty Princess Ayumi-chan.@
entries.target: 他对卡通人物,尤其是他的 @果,@ 艾米-,来自 @漂亮的阿米公主.@

entries.source: Sells various odds and ends in his shop. He's grown to care for Leaf and Petal as if they were his own, and secretly marks down his prices when they're the ones buying.
entries.target: 他的店里出售各种杂货。他已经把叶子和花瓣当成自己的孩子般照顾，还会在他们购物时悄悄降价。

entries.source: Is very level-headed for her age, often chastising Leaf and Petal for their reckless behavior.
entries.target: 对于她的年龄来说,她很平衡,经常责备叶子和子,因为他们的鲁行为.

entries.source: Young has been the Mayor of Canopy Town ever since he was young. Since the town has no formal political positions, his title is purely for fun.
entries.target: 由于该镇没有正式的政治职位,他的头是纯粹的乐趣.

entries.source: She spends all day hanging around her cats even though she's allergic to them. She either loves them that much or can't stand being around people.
entries.target: 她花了整天在猫周围,尽管她对它们过敏.她要么爱它们,要么不能忍受与人在一起.

entries.source: Judy's pet cats. They get along as if they were siblings. The question is whether or not they get along with YOU.
entries.target: 朱迪的猫,他们好像是兄弟姐妹,问题是,他们是否和你相处.

entries.source: Yearns to live in a world filled with vibrant colors. Until that's possible, he'd rather resign himself to his secluded, cut-away stump. How does he do that?
entries.target: 他渴望生活在充满活力的颜色的世界.直到这可能,他宁愿屈服于他的孤立,切断的茎.

entries.source: A sheep on an adventure to find his sister.
entries.target: 一只羊在冒险中寻找他的妹妹.

entries.source: A magical automaton created with powerful magic. Still, he has a will of his own; they say he was sealed away after he turned on his creator.
entries.target: 由强大魔法创造的魔法自动机。但他拥有自己的意志；据说他在反抗创造者后被封印了。

entries.source: An excitable dog that was sealed inside of a chest for being too rowdy. Once freed, he was eager to play with the first person in sight; Leaf was not amused by this.
entries.target: 一个激动人心的狗,因为他太乱,被封在胸前.一旦被释放,他渴望和看到的第一个人一起玩;这对叶子来说并不有趣.

entries.source: He owns nearly two dozen cows at his farm, and most of them like to take walks down to the pasture to get their exercise in. If only there weren't so many monsters around.
entries.target: 他农场有近二十头牛,他们大多数都喜欢走到草原去炼.

entries.source: Even though he hasn't been able to tip over a cow just yet, his constant attempts to do so make his father angry. The cows, however, couldn't care less.
entries.target: 虽然他还没有过一头牛,但他不断地试图过一头牛,这让他的父亲生气.

entries.source: The oldest cow on George's farm. She nearly falls asleep from being rocked back and forth by Lucas.
entries.target: 乔治的农场最老的牛,因为卢卡斯摇摇摇,几乎睡着了.

entries.source: This primian spends way too much time thinking about nothing important. Your average philosopher.
entries.target: 这位普里米亚人花太多时间思考什么都不重要.

entries.source: When a certain troublemaking wizard flicked the Mother Stalk, Peamaster was the only peaman to land within the immediate vicinity. He's been waiting ever since for the return of his friends.
entries.target: 当一个麻烦的巫师着母亲的子时, 皮马斯特是唯一一个登陆的士.

entries.source: He'll do anything in order to NOT do anything. Even the promise of a wish come true won't motivate Ned; he'd rather you do the work.
entries.target: 他会做任何事情,以免做任何事情. 即使一个愿望的承诺都不会激励内德;他更喜欢你做工作.

entries.source: This ogre has conquered over 12 villages and terrorized countless citizens for years before he was sealed away. Now he's free to roam the lands once more.
entries.target: 这位子已经征服了 12 他被封锁之前,他多年来一直恐吓着无数公民.

entries.source: She once had a nightmare that every store and restaurant had become completely empty--even her beloved Tree Sap Tavern. Ever since, she has savored every sip.
entries.target: 她曾经梦见过,每家店铺和餐厅都变得完全空,甚至是她最爱的树酒馆.

entries.source: Known by everyone as an extraordinarily happy child, her attitude slowly mellowed out as the harsh realities of the world began to wear her down.
entries.target: 她曾是人尽皆知的开心果，但随着残酷的现实不断消磨她，她的性格也渐渐沉稳了下来。

entries.source: Delirious late-night patrons of the Tree Sap Tavern tell stories about a @mysterious creature@ living in the pond: the truth is, Ikan's always there to save them from drowning when they stumble over the edge.
entries.target: 树酒馆的狂热深夜客户讲述了 @神秘的生物@ 实际上,伊坎总是帮助他们,当他们倒在边缘时,

entries.source: A real ladies man, Gunter has hit on over 3000 different women in his lifetime. His ability to remain single in spite of such a feat is perhaps what's more impressive.
entries.target: 特是个真正的女士,他打了我 3000 他仍然是单身的,尽管如此,但这也许是最令人印象深刻的.

entries.source: When Lissa's parents passed, she was left to run the Tree Sap Tavern with her brother, Louis, at relatively young ages. Still, they have done well to preserve the legacy and reputation of their famous tree sap.
entries.target: 丽莎的父母去世后,她和弟弟路易在相对年轻的时候就被遗留在"树酒馆"里,管理了树酒店.

entries.source: Hopelessly alone, Bart dreams of just one thing: a woman's phone number. And no, his mother's doesn't count.
entries.target: 只有一个事,巴特梦想着一个女人电话号码.

entries.source: Mr. Brown has led a mysterious life full of adventure. However, the elusive Sacred Slabs have remained out of his reach. Whether he'd like to admit it, he may be getting too old to ever find them himself.
entries.target: 布朗先生过着充满冒险的神秘生活,然而,难以捉摸的圣仍然是他无法接触的.不管他是否想承认,他可能太老了,无法自己找到它们.

entries.source: He has always looked up to Lissa, his older sister, for keeping the Tree Sap Tavern from falling apart. Now he does his best to lighten her burden, including preparing much of the tree sap himself.
entries.target: 他一直向他的姐姐丽斯拉表示赞赏,因为她保证了树酒店不会崩.

entries.source: She was convinced by a friend to finally give dating sites a chance. So far, she's not convinced it was actually a good idea.
entries.target: 她被一个朋友说服,终于给约会网站一个机会.

entries.source: Frank travelled all the way from The Dreadlands to see the girl he met online. He's hoping to change his ways and become a nicer person: he's even paying for the drinks!
entries.target: 他希望改变自己的方式,成为一个更好的人:他甚至付费了饮料!

entries.source: David can go days in total isolation: just him, nature, and his music. However, that doesn't mean he's antisocial. He'd be more than happy if you gave some of his tunes a listen--even if they're unfinished.
entries.target: 戴维可以一个人隔绝数日，只与自然和音乐为伴。但这并不代表他不合群。要是你愿意听听他的曲子，哪怕还没写完，他也会非常高兴。

entries.source: A wooden doll brought to life. Don't be fooled by her looks; she could knock you out in over 100 different ways. . . But she has no reason to do that, right?
entries.target: 让她看起来不错,她可能会让你倒下. 100 但她没有理由这样做,对吧?

entries.source: Thorn has lived a complicated life marred with questionable decisions. But after a series of realizations she's vowed to only do the right thing--even if she's still wrong.
entries.target: 恩过着复杂的生活,被可疑的决定所染,但经过一系列的认识,她发誓只会做正确的事情,

entries.source: One day when he was skydiving, he accidentally landed in the angels' Sacred Palace. The thing he loves about skydiving is the amazing views you can see, but he never expected this.
entries.target: 他喜欢跳空的东西是你能看到的惊人的景色,但他从来没有预料到这么做.

entries.source: Is overly concerned with how she comes off to others. Even if she's only regularly interacted with the same group of five people for thousands of years.
entries.target: 太担心她对别人表现得好,即使她只经常与同一个五个人群体交往,

entries.source: She believes herself to be the most beautiful of all the angels. She moves as little as possible to avoid forming wrinkles. It is unknown if angels can even form them, but she's not about to find out.
entries.target: 她认为自己是天使中最美丽的.她尽可能少地移动以避免形成纹.不知道天使是否能形成它们,但她还没有发现.

entries.source: A complete know-it-all. And it's actually true! She enjoys coming up with quizes just so she can flex exactly how much of it all she knows.
entries.target: 她喜欢提出测试,只是为了让她能炼自己所知道的.

entries.source: She deemed herself @queen@ of the angels merely because of her age. The others hardly cared enough to protest, as it doesn't mean much anyway. But she does get to sit on a big throne.
entries.target: 她只因年纪最大，就自封为天使们的@女王@。其他人觉得这个称号没什么意义，懒得反对。不过她确实因此坐上了一张大王座。

entries.source: She's the lore keeper in charge of reminding everyone what their purpose is supposed to be. Though it's not like they actually need reminding in order to spy on mortals.
entries.target: 她是传说的守护者,负责提醒每个人都应该有什么目的,虽然他们不需要提醒,

entries.source: Courtney is usually in charge of this orb. But I guess she dropped it; how clumsy of her. The angels would often gather around it to gossip about the mortals depicted inside.
entries.target: 特尼通常负责这个球球,但我猜她放下了它,这是多么拙的.天使经常聚集在它周围,

entries.source: Lock picking is easy for an expert thief like Mark, but even a master lock picker couldn't escape the inside of a magical chest. Not the best idea to steal from Willow the Wizard.
entries.target: 像马克这样的专业盗窃者, 锁选很容易, 但即使是一个精英的锁选手, 也无法逃离一个魔术的箱子.

entries.source: Blaine is part of a burgeoning wave of collectors who tend to seek out the unexpected. They understand the potential value in almost everything, even if said value has yet to become apparent.
entries.target: 布莱恩是收集者的一群成长的成员,他们倾向于寻找意想不到的东西.

entries.source: Overworked and underpaid, an average workday is 10 to 12 hours for Mr. Miller. Not even watching virtual streamers helps cheer him up anymore. It would take a miracle to turn his life around at this point.
entries.target: 过度工作和低薪,平均工作日为 10 为了 12 现在,他需要一个奇迹,才能改变他的生活.

entries.source: A stray that Pawla eventually stopped trying to shoo away. And if she's not careful, Heathrow won't be the last one.
entries.target: 如果她不小心,希思罗不会是最后一个.

entries.source: Unlike other collectors, Pawla doesn't follow arbitrary, self-imposed rules such as @no stealing.@ Some things simply must be taken if you want them. And she wants many, many things.
entries.target: 与其他收藏家不同，波拉不遵守诸如@禁止偷窃。@这种任意定下的规矩。想要某些东西，就只能直接拿走。而她想要的东西可多得很。

entries.source: Willow is his idol. Corey's purchased all of Willow's exclusive merch and even started a fan club where he is the only member.
entries.target: 科里已经购买了威洛的所有专属商品,甚至创办了一个粉丝俱乐部,

entries.source: The legend of the great ninja Smonkith is the reason he became a Primian Ninja. Greddy worked his way up the ninja ladder and is now 2nd in command. If only he could get his fellow ninjas to take their job seriously.
entries.target: 伟大忍者斯蒙基斯的传说促使他成为普里米安忍者。格雷迪一步步晋升，如今已是二把手。要是能让同伴们认真对待工作就好了。

entries.source: Yurple joined the Primian Ninjas to prove his excellent navigation skills. He's especially skilled at giving gaming advice.
entries.target: 尤尔普尔加入了"原始忍者"来证明他的优秀导航技能. 他特别擅长提供游戏建议.

entries.source: One of the perks of being a Primian Ninja is getting to enjoy the stolen goods. Blorp stole this new game from a kid in Canopy Town and now all the primians want to play it.
entries.target: 作为一个普里米亚忍者的一种优势是享受被盗的东西.

entries.source: The cheering primians have been waiting for the return of their original leader, Smonkith, who was sealed away nearly 300 years ago. Little did they know he was in the very treasure chest they were guarding.
entries.target: 欢呼的普里米亚人一直在等待原始领导人斯蒙基斯的回归, 300 几年前,他们不知道他是藏在他们守护的宝箱里.

entries.source: Around 300 years ago Smonkith was the founder and leader of the Primian Ninjas. His animosity towards humans became stronger after his encounter with Willow, whom he caught in the act of theft.
entries.target: 周围 300 斯蒙基斯是普林尼日亚的创始人和领导人.他对人类的敌意在与威洛相遇后变得更强烈,

entries.source: He was tied up by the Primian Ninjas to be used as a @flying taxi.@ His father found himself in the same situation, but both were fortunate enough to be rescued. Now he voluntarily acts as a @flying taxi@!
entries.target: 他被原始忍者绑起来, @飞行出租车.@ 他父亲发现自己处于同样的境地,但他们俩都很幸运被救出来. @飞行出租车@!

entries.source: The mother of all Peamen: special beings that sprouted from her tall body long ago. Because her own energy was used to make them, she now relies on their presence in order to function.
entries.target: 由于她自己的能量被用来创造它们,她现在依赖于它们的存在来运作.

entries.source: This maid wasn't too thrilled to discover that her client had been a wizard this entire time. Don't they have spells for cleaning up? The least he could have done was paid her fairly.
entries.target: 这位女仆发现她的客户一直都是巫师,并没有太高兴了.他们没有什么清洁的咒语吗?

entries.source: Ricky has lived at Shellfish Docks his entire life and never ventured to the outside world. He gets upset whenever an outsider comes around his home because he's afraid of what he doesn't know.
entries.target: 里基一生都住在海港,从来没有冒险进入外界.他每当外人来到他的家里,都会生气,因为他害怕他不知道的事情.

entries.source: Every morning she wanders around the boardwalks collecting shell slugs to cook for her dad, Earl, and grandpa, Ricky. She likes to use any extra shells to make hair clips.
entries.target: 每天早上,她在路边散步,收集子,为她的父亲,埃尔,和祖父,里基做饭.

entries.source: Worked his entire life at the docks and hoped his sons would follow in his footsteps. Unfortunately for Earl his sons left home to follow their dreams. He blames himself for failing them as a father.
entries.target: 他希望他的儿子会跟随他的脚步,不幸的是,他的儿子离开家去追求他们的梦想.

entries.source: All Melissa wants to do is have fun every day. She loves to swim and run around the boardwalks. Sometimes she plays with Heidi, and they find shells together.
entries.target: 梅丽莎每天都想玩得很好,她喜欢游泳,在海道上跑步,有时她和海迪玩,他们一起找到了子.

entries.source: Griselda is focused on never missing a moment of her daughter's life. If only she had a way to capture these moments so she can relive them later.
entries.target: 格里塞尔达的重点是永远不要错过女儿的生活的一瞬间.

entries.source: He buys raw shell slugs from Heidi and turns them into @Shell Slug Snacks@ before reselling them. No one actually knows what goes into making them @snacks,@ but they do taste good.
entries.target: 他从海蒂那里买来生壳蛞蝓，加工成@壳蛞蝓零食@后转卖。没人知道它们究竟怎么变成了@零食，@但味道确实不错。

entries.source: Gully often gives Griselda a hard time by pecking at her hair. Once Gully managed to nest in her hair for 3 weeks without her knowing.
entries.target: 格利经常用子着格里塞尔达的头发来困扰格利尔达. 3 几周,她不知道.

entries.source: Fishing is his life but lately the piranhas have been preventing him from catching anything worthwhile. His son Arthur used to help keep the piranhas away but he's busy over in the big city.
entries.target: 钓鱼就是他的人生，但最近食人鱼害得他什么好东西都钓不到。他的儿子亚瑟过去会帮忙赶走食人鱼，如今却在大城市里忙得不可开交。

entries.source: Ever since her brother left, she's been worried that he might forget her birthday. She's hoping for something fancy this time since he's living it up in the big city.
entries.target: 自从她的兄弟离开以来,她担心他可能忘记了她的生日.她希望这一次有什么奢的东西,因为他在大城市生活.

entries.source: This seagull stays around Bubba's boat because Kriss often gives him handouts. Seaguss also steals fish from Bubba, much to his dismay.
entries.target: 鱼在巴巴的船上停留,因为克里斯经常给他一些手工.

entries.source: Dr. Hack's first succesful animal rescue. You don't want to see the unsuccessful ones.
entries.target: 哈克博士第一次成功拯救动物,你不想看到那些失败的动物.

entries.source: Dr. Hack doubted that this animal would ever be able to fly again. But it can at least hop around like a champ.
entries.target: 哈克博士怀疑这个动物能再次飞行,但至少可以像冠军一样跳跃.

entries.source: One of Dr. Hack's most successful attempts to rescue an injured animal. She can still speak and understands the world around her.
entries.target: 哈克博士拯救受伤动物最成功的尝试之一。她依然能说话，也理解周围的世界。

entries.source: A scientist who lost his arm after a vicious sharpunch attack. Miraculously, he was saved by an unknown sea creature. Ever since, he has devoted his life to rescuing animals in need--albeit through unconventional means.
entries.target: 一位科学家在一个残酷的尖攻击后失去他的手臂. 奇迹般地,他被一个未知的海洋生物拯救出来. 从那时起,他把他的生命献给了救助需要的动物--

entries.source: After being tricked by his fellow Primian Pirates, his death was almost certain. But Dr. Hack was able save his life; what's more, he also equipped him with stronger bubble burst attacks and cool jet-powered legs!
entries.target: 哈克博士还能拯救他的生命,而且还能给他提供更强大的泡爆发攻击和冷静的喷气动力腿!

entries.source: Lubby became disheartened when he realized how lame he was compared to his big bro, so he set off on a journey to fix that. And then he gave up immediately. What exactly is he missing?
entries.target: 卢比意识到他与大哥相比是多么,所以他开始了修复这个问题.

entries.source: Leslie loves the ocean. But especially the @trash@ that washes ashore. You wouldn't believe what people toss overboard. Like just the other day, she found a pair of old sneakers--WITH the laces!
entries.target: 莱斯利喜欢海洋, @垃圾@ 像前一天,她发现了一双旧的运动鞋,带着链条.

entries.source: Although he looks old, his appearance is acually just due to being thrown too hard into the ocean. He is old, of course, but so are all clay folk.
entries.target: 他看起来很老,但他的外观是因为他被扔到大海.

entries.source: Gypsumike is the best stone mason in Clay Folk Colony. But even he doesn't compare to the original builders that were originally there. He hopes to achieve that same level of stonework eventually.
entries.target: 吉普斯皮米是民殖民地最好的石匠,但他也没有与原始建筑师相比,他希望最终能达到同样的石头工艺水平.

entries.source: Kklip loves to count. And that's just about it.
entries.target: 克利普喜欢计算,就算是这样.

entries.source: She would like nothing more than to own a pet. But most of them can't breathe underwater. And fish just don't make very good pets.
entries.target: 她最大的愿望就是养一只宠物。可大多数动物都不能在水下呼吸，而鱼又算不上什么好宠物。

entries.source: Kkerelia is always hoping that more visitors would show up at Clay Folk Colony. It gets boring with no one new to interact with for hundreds of years.
entries.target: 克克里利亚一直希望更多的游客会到克莱民间殖民地.

entries.source: Korkke's imagination is immeasurable. So he couldn't care less whether visitors decide to show up or not; inside his head, it's always something interesting.
entries.target: 科尔克的想象力是不可估量的,所以他不管访客是否决定出现,

entries.source: He's not a child, okay!? He's a full-grown ADULT who likes ADULT things!
entries.target: 他不是一个孩子,他是一个成年人,喜欢成年人!

entries.source: Forakkaloni managed to find a purpose by opening up a store. It doesn't get very many customers, but the fact that it might is enough to keep him going.
entries.target: 福拉克卡洛尼通过开设一个商店来找到一个目的. 它没有很多客户,但事实上,它可能足以让他继续前进.

entries.source: Kkwartz is starting to ponder what it is he should be doing with his life. Sometimes he thinks about starting a water park on the surface. But that would be so much work. . .
entries.target: 克瓦茨开始思考他应该用自己的生活做什么.有时他想在表面上开设一个水上公园.但这将是太多的工作. . . .

entries.source: He spent many years in isolation in order to heighten his senses. Eventually, he aqcuired what could be described as magical abilities. He then knew what he had to do: make money selling his services.
entries.target: 他花了许多年时间在隔离中,以提高自己的感觉.最后,他获得了可以称之为魔法能力.

entries.source: She used to be just a regular housewife doing her best for her newborn baby. But the same couldn't be said about her husband. Everything was always only about him.
entries.target: 她只是一个普通的家庭主妇,为她新生儿做出了一切努力.

entries.source: One day while fishing, he was attacked by the Crusty Crooks and ended up on a small island. Now he's stranded on this plant-filled island without any water.
entries.target: 一天,当他着鱼时,他被鱼袭击了,最终就被困在一个小岛上.

entries.source: A happy dentist who always came to work with a smile on his face. And he was always happy to give proper smiles on others' faces too. However, one customer just would not let that happen.
entries.target: 他总是带着微笑来工作的快乐的牙医.他总是很高兴地让别人的脸上也会有正确的微笑.

entries.source: Merpeople are strangely attracted to the scents of their potential mates. And for Glubbo, he stumbled upon the jackpot inside of a chest. But in a cruel twist of fate, he was unable to open it.
entries.target: 人很奇怪地被潜在的伴侣的气味吸引,而格鲁布博却在胸前发现了奖,

entries.source: Aurelia was born with a rare birth defect that causes merpeople to have humanoid features on top rather than on the bottom. This makes her very undesirable to other merpeople.
entries.target: 奥莱利亚天生患有一种罕见缺陷，使人鱼的人形特征出现在上半身，而不是下半身。因此，其他人鱼都觉得她毫无魅力。

entries.source: Mr. Mallory gets annoyed when people sit too close to him while he's fishing. Because then they get annoyed when his lure inevitably smacks them in the face. And somehow it's HIS problem.
entries.target: 马洛里先生很生气,当人们坐在他身边的时候,因为他捕鱼的时候,他们会生气,

entries.source: The only clay folk left on the surface where the angels used to live. He now spends his days trying to solve the mystery of the Sacred Slabs.
entries.target: 他是天使旧居地表面上仅存的泥人。如今，他每天都在试图解开神圣石板之谜。

entries.source: Belle spent most of her life working in the carnival but after all these years she feels the pull to do something different. Now, with her partner in crime, Chime, the two have set out to change the world!
entries.target: 贝尔大部分生活都在嘉年华工作,但经过这么多年,她觉得自己需要做别的事情.

entries.source: She finally got that job at the office she'd always wanted. But she's starting to question if all the stress is worth it. Now she consumes roughly 6 cups of coffee a day.
entries.target: 她终于得到了她一直想要的办公室工作,但她开始怀疑所有的压力是否值得. 6 每天喝一杯咖啡.

entries.source: She slowly becoming Stucky O'Maly's number 1 fan. Just look at all the amazing new shops and services he's opened! He must be so busy!
entries.target: 她正慢慢成为斯塔基·奥马利的头号粉丝。看看他新开了这么多厉害的商店和服务！他一定忙坏了！

entries.source: Inventing gadgets and modifying cars are pastimes of his. Billy was hoping to get the newest @Finally Fancy@ game, but he never imagined it would sell out.
entries.target: 发明设备和修改汽车是他的爱好. @最后,我很想@ 他想不到它会卖掉.

entries.source: Spends most of his days training in martial arts to be the greatest fighter. When he's not training, he likes to chill with friends. Sometimes he gives his friends a hard time.
entries.target: 他大部分时间都在练习武术，只为成为最强的格斗家。不训练时，他喜欢和朋友们放松，偶尔也会故意给他们出难题。

entries.source: To Moe, there's nothing better than sipping a cold one while mowing the lawn. He's a man of the past and really loves retro games like @Dark Soldier 2.@ Don't even get him started on modern games.
entries.target: 莫的感觉比在剪草时喝冰冷的酒更好. @黑暗的士兵 2.@ 让他开始玩现代游戏.

entries.source: Theo enjoys playing video games so he thought it would be a good idea to work at Stucky Games, but it ended up being a big mistake. He's got many horror stories to tell about unreasonable customers.
entries.target: 喜欢玩电子游戏,所以他认为工作在Stucky Games是个好主意,但最终是个大错误.

entries.source: Asking a girl out has never been one of his strong points, but he continues to try anyway. If only he could read the room or maybe brush his teeth, then he might be successful one of these days.
entries.target: 邀请一个女孩出去从来不是他强大的点之一,但他仍然努力.如果他能读一读房间或洗牙,那么他可能会成功.

entries.source: After her shift is over, Bridget is going to StuckyCon to meet up with her friends, Fay and Thomas. Until then she must put up with this dreadful job.
entries.target: 在她班结束后,布里吉特要去StuckyCon和她的朋友Fay和Thomas见面.

entries.source: He takes his job at Stucky Games very seriously. He trained for 4 years and got 6 different degrees before he felt qualified for this job. Maybe one day he'll be manager of the store.
entries.target: 他非常认真地接受了他的工作. 4 几年后, 6 他觉得自己适合这个工作之前,他已经有了不同的学位.

entries.source: He is never ashamed of the media he enjoys. If someone dislikes what he likes, they're simply wrong.
entries.target: 他从来没有因为喜欢的媒体感到羞愧.

entries.source: Charles is very passionate about video games, especially @Speedzo the Hamster@ games. He likes to create his own Speedzo original characters and make up stories with them.
entries.target: 查尔斯对电子游戏非常热爱, @鱼的鱼@ 他喜欢创造自己的Speedzo原始角色,并用它们创造故事.

entries.source: Every day after school, Hubert goes to Stucky Games to hang out and chat with fellow game enthusiasts. He enjoys gaming classics like @Mega Romeo.@
entries.target: 每天放学后，休伯特都会去斯塔基游戏店，和其他游戏爱好者一起消磨时间、聊天。他喜欢@超级罗密欧@之类的经典游戏。

entries.source: Working at Stuckies Trucking is beginning to take a toll on Sharon's health. The long hours and lack of air-conditioned trucks are enough to get anyone down. Maybe one day she can get a job using her coding skills.
entries.target: 工作在Stuckies卡车开始对夏伦的健康造成影响. 长时间和空调卡车的缺乏足以让任何人下降.

entries.source: Level-headed and dependable, Jimmy is never one to fall for obvious scams. He's beginning to think there might be a connection between the Gangster Goons and the head of the biggest company on the planet.
entries.target: 他开始认为, 帮派子和地球上最大公司的负责人之间可能有联系.

entries.source: Playing video games all day is Victor's idea of a perfect day. A high paying gig, like what the Gangster Goons are offering him, is very tempting to him because more money means more games.
entries.target: 像帮派帮派所提供的高薪演出一样,对他来说是很诱人的,因为更多的钱意味着更多的游戏.

entries.source: A good dog who would never bite. But Leaf is still just as terrified as ever.
entries.target: 一个不敢咬的狗,但叶子仍然像往常一样害怕.

entries.source: Liam found Teddy on the side of the road as a puppy. It didn't take long for him to learn tricks, either, like @don't pee inside the house.@
entries.target: 利安发现泰迪在路边,当他还是一个狗. @不要在房子里尿.@

entries.source: Tom is the lead striker on his team, and he has the record for most goals scored in one game. The success has made him a bit arrogant.
entries.target: 姆是他的球队的首席进攻者,他拥有在一场比赛中最多进球的记录.成功使他有点傲慢.

entries.source: He used to be on the same team as Tom, but Blake was traded to the Red Slithers. They now have a strong rivalry and compete to be the best striker.
entries.target: 他曾经和姆同一个球队,但布莱克被交换到红色滑板队.他们现在有着强大的竞争,并争夺成为最佳进攻者.

entries.source: Sarah spends all of her time reading books alone. But she secretly wishes she had someone else to share them with. However, all of her attempts to make friends in the past were unsuccessful.
entries.target: 莎拉花了所有的时间独自阅读书籍.但她秘密希望有别人分享这些书籍.

entries.source: Jesse has been streaming video games for over 10 years now. Who'd have thought something like this could be a job!
entries.target: 杰西已经播放了视频游戏 10 谁会想到这样的东西可能是一个工作!

entries.source: A world-famous live streamer known for his extremely difficult video game challenge runs. Some say they're not even mathematically possible. . .
entries.target: 一位世界知名的直播播播员,他以极其艰难的电子游戏挑战运行.

entries.source: An avid speedrunner who holds many records. The secret to his skills is his commitment to the gym.
entries.target: 他是热爱跑步者,拥有许多纪录,他的技能的秘密是他对健身房的承诺.

entries.source: A world-famous live streamer known for his speedrunning skills and his advocacy for both physical and mental health. And just wait until you see him on a dance pad!
entries.target: 他是世界著名的直播播播员,他以跑步技巧和对身体和精神健康的倡导而闻名.

entries.source: When he loves certain video games, he'll learn every single thing about them--including things the developers didn't know. If glitches are in a game's code, they're fair play!
entries.target: 他喜欢某些电子游戏,他会学到关于它们的每一个东西,包括开发者不知道的事情.

entries.source: Alissa loves to speedrun games, although she's not necessarily the best at them. But, to her, having fun is more important than having world records. And that's why the viewers love her.
entries.target: 艾丽莎喜欢跑步,虽然她不一定是最好的,但她认为,有趣比拥有世界纪录更重要,

entries.source: While on a fancy date with her new boyfriend, she was caught off guard by someone she may or may not have known. Either way, she didn't expect to be sealed inside of a chest for so long.
entries.target: 在她与新男友的的约会上,她可能或许不知道的人突然抓住了她.

entries.source: He didn't know what he was getting into when he decided to take Amelia out on a date. Now they're both living in a completely different time.
entries.target: 他不知道他在什么时候决定带阿美莉亚出去约会.

entries.source: Rolkke was getting very bored of his undersea life, so he moved away to the big city in hopes of finding something interesting. He is a rather weird person, so it has been difficult finding any friends.
entries.target: 罗尔克开始厌倦他的海底生活,所以他搬到大城市,希望找到一些有趣的事情.他是一个相当奇怪的人,所以很难找到任何朋友.

entries.source: She's a doctor who used to work in the emergency room at the downtown hospital. She recently got a promotion and now works at one of Stucky's fancy new hospitals.
entries.target: 她是医生,曾经在市中心医院的急诊室工作,最近被晋升,现在她在斯塔基的新医院之一工作.

entries.source: All he wants to do is make his wife, Brie, happy. She's been working too much lately, so he decided to take her to a fancy event.
entries.target: 他只想让妻子布里快乐,她最近一直在工作太多,所以他决定带她去一个豪华的活动.

entries.source: Likes to live out his fantasies through cosplaying his favorite character. He does it so much that he's starting to believe he actually is @George Cosmostroller.@
entries.target: 他喜欢通过演出自己最喜欢的角色来活出自己的幻想. 他这么做了,他开始相信自己真的很棒. @乔治·宇宙旅行者.@

entries.source: Lives alone with her widowed father. Overseas cartoons, especially magical girl shows, have helped her stay cheerful throughout her life. Maybe she's a bit too cheerful, but it has helped her make friends.
entries.target: 她和她的父亲独自生活.海外卡通,尤其是魔术女孩节目,帮助她一生保持欢乐.

entries.source: Has a natural talent for writing. They started a review article net page and became rather popular and respected for their opinions. Finding anything worth watching has become rather difficult.
entries.target: 对于他们的观点,他们开始了一个评论文章网页,成为相当受欢迎和受尊重.

entries.source: Jeffrey has big aspirations of becoming rich and famous. He took a job at a fancy hotel to try and get in with all the bigwigs, but he didn't expect for there to be @nerd@ conventions held there.
entries.target: 杰弗里有着很大的愿望成为富人和名人. 他接受了一份高档酒店的工作, @子@ 会议在那里举行.

entries.source: Head of a massively successful company and the 8th richest man on the planet. He gained his success rather underhandedly by making shady deals with Stucky O'Maly.
entries.target: 他掌管着一家极其成功的公司，也是全球第8富有的人。他靠与斯塔基·奥马利进行见不得人的交易取得了成功。

entries.source: Loves to travel around the city finding the best places to eat.  He heard a convention for Stucky was being held at this hotel, but he didn't expect it to be a cartoon convention for @nerds.@
entries.target: 他听说斯塔基在酒店举行了会议,但他没有想到它会是卡通会议, @蛋.@

entries.source: Inherited her wealth through her family's fashion empire. She once won the Miss O'Maly competition by rigging the votes, even though she would have won regardless.
entries.target: 她的财富来自家族的时尚帝国。她曾通过操纵选票赢得“奥马利小姐”比赛，尽管她本来也能获胜。

entries.source: Stucky O'Maly is an idol to her. She buys everything from Stucky O Mart and even hires him for all her legal needs. She hopes one day he will notice her fur company so she can join the O'maly family.
entries.target: 她买了所有东西,甚至雇佣了他,以满足所有法律需求.她希望有一天他会注意到她的皮革公司,

entries.source: A professional photographer who has even taken the billboard photos of O'Maly himself. He made enough money from Stucky that he can now pursue his passion for photoing cartoon and gaming cosplayers.
entries.target: 他是专业摄影师，甚至为奥马利本人拍过广告牌照片。他从斯塔基那里赚到了足够的钱，如今可以专心拍摄动漫和游戏角色扮演者。

entries.source: Winston was a scaredy-cat when he was little, so he decided to overcome his fears by playing scary games like @Silent Ridge.@ Cosplaying the main character, Point Head, has helped him a lot.
entries.target: 温斯顿小时候很害怕,所以他决定通过玩恐怖游戏来克服自己的恐惧 @沉默的.@ 让他看起主角,点头,有助于他.

entries.source: jasmine has 2 million followers on her picture net space. She's constantly on the lookout for interesting and unique things to get her more and more likes.
entries.target: 茶菉在图片社交空间拥有两百万粉丝。她总在寻找有趣又独特的事物，好让自己获得更多点赞。

entries.source: Has a very large collection of overseas cartoons. She hopes to one day watch them all, but there are so many that it might be impossible.
entries.target: 她希望有一天能看全部的海外卡通,但它们太多了,这可能是不可能的.

entries.source: Leela is what some might call a @normie.@ She tends to like things that are popular within her friend group. Currently her friends are into seasonal cartoons, so she makes sure to keep up with them.
entries.target: 李拉是一些人称之为 @诺米.@ 她喜欢在朋友群中受欢迎的东西.目前她的朋友喜欢季节性卡通,所以她确保跟上它们.

entries.source: Rather than watch what everyone else is watching, Fay tries to keep up with the shows with the highest ratings. No time for the popular seasonal trash, she needs the 90% critic rated shows.
entries.target: 费伊试图跟上那些有最高评级的节目. 90评论家评价的节目.

entries.source: Likes to watch overseas cartoons in the language they were made in. He thinks since he's watched four shows he's learned a foreign language, but he's still got a lot to learn.
entries.target: 他喜欢用原创语言看海外卡通,因为他看了四部节目,他学到了外国语言,但他还有很多东西要学.

entries.source: Decision making isn't Tatiana's strong suit. She once lost a school scholarship due to her indecisiveness. Hopefully she doesn't miss the con because she's stuck at this vending machine.
entries.target: 决策不是塔蒂亚娜的强大力. 她曾经因为不决心而失去学金. 希望她不会错过骗局,因为她被这个自动售货机困住.

entries.source: Enjoys cute girl cosplayers. She takes a photo every time she sees one, so she's built up quite the collection.
entries.target: 她每次看到一个照片都会拍照,所以她已经积累了大量的收藏品.

entries.source: Loves to cosplay, however due to her extreme social anxiety she almost never does. This is her first time ever cosplaying in public.
entries.target: 她喜欢做爱情,但由于她极度的社会焦虑,她几乎从来没有.

entries.source: He quit his job at the Tree Sap Tavern to pursue his dream of making a video game. His dream game is one inspired by all the overseas cartoons he's watched.
entries.target: 他辞去了"树酒馆"的工作, 为了追求他的梦想, 制作一个电子游戏. 他的梦想游戏是他看过的所有海外卡通作品的灵感.

entries.source: Alex has a habit of relying on his father's money and partying with all his friends, so his dad got him a job at this hotel to teach him a little structure.
entries.target: 亚历克斯有习惯依靠父亲的钱和所有的朋友一起聚会,所以他的父亲给他一个工作在这个酒店教他一个结构.

entries.source: Finnick enjoys watching, reading, playing, cosplaying and collecting anything @nerdy.@ He recently beat the @Star Brawl@ game for the 53rd time and he's planning on beating it again today.
entries.target: 芬尼克喜欢观看、阅读、游玩、角色扮演和收藏一切@宅向@的东西。他最近第53次通关了@星际大乱斗@，还打算今天再通关一次。

entries.source: He once drove 3000 miles to stand in line for 35 hours for a premium release exclusive @Pretty Princess Ayumi-chan@ tissue box. He is very dedicated to his collecting.
entries.target: 他曾经开车 3000 站在队列里 35 限额发放时间 @漂亮的公主艾米@ 他非常专注于收藏.

entries.source: Caleb is very dedicated to collecting the rarest and most valuable merch from overseas to sell at his shop. Traveling around from con to con gets expensive, but the rare merch helps pay for it.
entries.target: 凯莱布专门从海外收集最稀有、最珍贵的周边商品在店里出售。辗转各地参加展会成本高昂，但稀有商品的收益足以支撑旅费。

entries.source: Farmer George's oldest son. He moved away to the big city to escape the farming life. His Passion is for overseas entertainment, especially @Pretty Princess Ayumi-chan.@
entries.target: 他搬到大城市逃离农业生活.他的热情是海外娱乐, @漂亮的阿米公主.@

entries.source: Virtual Streamers have taken over his life. He watches Suika Utau's stream an unhealthy amount and it has begun to affect his mental wellbeing. What will he do when he finds out she's graduating?
entries.target: 他看着苏伊卡·乌塔乌的流量,不健康,开始影响他的心理健康.

entries.source: He spends most of his days complaining about the latest chapters of “Two Slice.” He's been reading it for over 20 years and considers himself a fan, but can he still call himself a fan if he hates it now?
entries.target: 他大部分时间都抱怨"两片"的最新章节. 20 他认为自己是粉丝,但如果现在恨他,他仍然可以称自己是粉丝吗?

entries.source: Art has always been her passion, having drawn consistently since she was very young. Many people enjoy her artistic style; However, some might find it to be a bit amateurish.
entries.target: 艺术一直是她的热情,自从她很年轻以来一直在不断地绘画.

entries.source: Rob is an enjoyer of everything overseas. His latest obsession is overseas live action special effects shows like @Pantherasaur Squadron Helmeted Troopers.@
entries.target: 他最近的痴迷是海外现场特效节目 @鱼队的头盔兵.@

entries.source: Has a strange acquaintance, Nelson, who always needs something from him. Nelson constantly tries to rope Damian into some sort of get-rich-quick scheme, but Damian is too wise for that.
entries.target: 尼尔逊不断试图把达米安入某种快速变富的计划中,但达米安对此太聪明.
像阿卡科·尤亚这样的著名偶像

entries.source: Sheldon comes all the way to StuckyCon from Shellfish Docks every year. He barely makes enough money to pay for the trip by working with his uncle, Bubba, on his fishing boat.
entries.target: 谢尔登每年从鱼码头到斯塔基康来,他几乎没有足够的钱,

entries.source: They go to StuckyCon to express themself in ways not otherwise possible. No one's gonna judge them at a place like that.
entries.target: 他们去StuckyCon表达自己以不可能的方式.

entries.source: Willie always wanted to be a famous singer. He took singing lessons and even tried out for a popular idol group. Unfortunately, he's not a very good singer, but he does have a sweet tooth, so he started a candy stand.
entries.target: 威利总是想成为一个著名的歌手. 他参加了歌唱课,甚至试图参加一个受欢迎的偶像团体. 不幸的是,他不是一个很好的歌手,但他确实有甜牙,所以他开始了糖果摊.

entries.source: Sam used to live in the slums downtown with his mom and sister. His grandfather hit the Stucky Lottery, and now his whole family lives in a fancy high-rise apartment.
entries.target: 萨姆以前和母亲、姐姐住在市中心的贫民窟。祖父中了斯塔基彩票后，全家都搬进了豪华高层公寓。

entries.source: Xorpy is an ex-member of the Primian Ninjas. He stole all their ninja weapons and decided to open a shop to sell them.  The Primian Ninjas still haven't replaced them, so they just attack with rocks and bubbles.
entries.target: 克索比是原始忍者成员,他偷了他们的忍者武器,决定开设一个商店卖它们.

entries.source: Fred's mom is a movie costume designer, so she often makes Fred high quality costumes to wear. He doesn't really like to cosplay, but he will do anything for his mother.
entries.target: 弗雷德的母亲是电影服装设计师，经常为他制作高品质戏服。他其实不太喜欢角色扮演，但为了母亲什么都愿意做。

entries.source: @Galaxy Brawl@ is one of her favorite movie series.  She once tried to speedrun the @Galaxy Brawl@ video game, but she wasn't very good at it.
entries.target: @银河斗争@ 她曾经试图加速 @银河斗争@ 她不太擅长电子游戏.

entries.source: Howie has never gone a day without running. In fact, they say he came out of the womb running; the doctors spent the entire evening chasing him down. He'll probably still be running at his funeral.
entries.target: 霍威从来没有跑过一天. 事实上,他们说他从子宫里跑了,医生整晚追着他.他可能还会在葬礼上跑.

entries.source: Going for records is what he's passionate about. Currently Tito's going for the record for longest time balancing a skateboard on top of a skyscraper.
entries.target: 他热衷于唱片,目前蒂托是最长时间在摩天大楼上平衡滑板的唱片.

entries.source: Crazy publicity stunts are what Trev is known for. In an effort to bring attention to the growing problem of Stucky's capitalism, Trev has been hanging off some of Stucky's most famous buildings.
entries.target: 为了引起人们的注意, 为了引起人们的注意, 为了引起人们的注意,

entries.source: Dustin always goes along with Howie's antics, but at what cost. . . ? A great cost, actually. The amount of cars he's had to purchase is through the roof. But if he truly hated it, he wouldn't do it.
entries.target: 达斯丁总是跟霍威的事,但以什么代价? ...一个很大的代价,实际上.他必须购买的汽车量是超高的.

entries.source: Eva has a belief that forgotten items contain spiritual energy that still lingers from when they were still cared for. If she can gather enough of this type of energy, she might be able to do incredible things. . .
entries.target: 伊娃相信,被遗忘的物品中仍然存在从被照顾时所存的精神能量.如果她能收集足够的这种能量,她可能会做出令人难以置信的事情. . . .

entries.source: George has lived downtown all his life, but lately he's been considering moving due to the recent violence happening all around the city.
entries.target: 乔治一生都住在市中心,但最近他一直在考虑搬迁,

entries.source: Bunsen was proud of the home he had created before being sealed away in that chest. It was made of a large shipping box filled with the latest newspapers and surrounded by the richest smelling garbage bags.
entries.target: 本生很为自己在被封进宝箱前打造的家感到骄傲。那是一只大运输箱，里面塞满最新报纸，周围还摆着气味最浓郁的垃圾袋。

entries.source: She's just about fed up with Stucky O'Maly's handling of the city. But there's only so much any individual person can do to change things. She wishes she could inspire others to take action as well.
entries.target: 她已经厌倦了Stucky O'Maly对城市的处理,但每个人只能做很多改变的事情.

entries.source: She used to be the owner of a hair salon but had to close because she couldn't compete with O'Maly's StuckyHair. After that she lost her house and is now forced to sleep on the streets.
entries.target: 她曾经是发型馆的主人,但不得不关闭,因为她不能与奥马利的发竞争.

entries.source: No one has ever seen what he keeps inside his suitcase. Some say he keeps the bodies of those he snatched up in the middle of the night. . . ! But it's probably his life savings.
entries.target: 现在,他还没有看到他把什么藏在行李箱里.有人说,他把那些在夜间抢走的尸体留下来.

entries.source: He's one of the last employees working at the Juicy Deli--and also its owner. It won't be long until it goes out of business, just like its competition run by fellow entrepreneurs.
entries.target: 他是最后一个在果汁店工作的员工之一,也是它的老板. 不久之后,它就会停产,就像同事企业家的竞争对手一样.

entries.source: Worked for Stucky as a technician until he was fired and replaced by drones. Now he finds himself homeless on the streets. On the bright side, he's found a new family here with the other homeless citizens.
entries.target: 他为斯塔基工作为技术人员,直到他被解雇,被无人机取代.现在他发现自己在街上无家可归.

entries.source: Danny hopes to change the world using the power of music. If he can turn just one frown upside down, then he's succeeded in life.
entries.target: 丹尼希望用音乐的力量改变世界.如果他能把一只脸倒,那么他已经成功了.

entries.source: With a voice as good as Emma's, you could be a star. It's just too bad she couldn't find that break-out gig, but at least she's happy singing for the needy.
entries.target: 姆娜的声音好,你可能会成为一个明星. 很遗憾她找不到那个脱欧演出,

entries.source: Overworked and underpaid, Shane has struggled to survive the harsh elements of the slums. Because of Stucky it's getting harder for smaller businesses to pay employees like Shane.
entries.target: 由于Stucky,小企业越来越难以支付像Shane这样的员工.

entries.source: Because of the rise of drone usage, Russell was fired from his job and is now forced to beg for money on the streets along with others in the downtown area. He blames the mayor for everything.
entries.target: 由于无人机使用的增加, 拉塞尔被解雇, 现在被迫在街上乞讨钱,

entries.source: He's only barely maintaining his sanity at the end of it all. His memories of the past are what keeps him going, but even those are slowly slipping away.
entries.target: 他几乎没有保持他的头脑在所有事情的结尾. 他过去的记忆是让他继续前进,

entries.source: When he looks at the state of the downtown area, all he sees is opportunity. The locals might not have much, but depserate people are the easiest to take advantage of. But what other options does he have?
entries.target: 他看到的只有机会,当地人可能没有很多,但丧的人最容易利用.

entries.source: He always wanted to help people, which is why he became a first responder. But now he feels more helpless than ever without the necessary equipment to actually deal with most emergencies.
entries.target: 他一直想帮助别人，所以成了应急人员。但没有处理大多数紧急情况所需的设备，他现在反而比以往更感到无助。

entries.source: She would love to help you with your health problems. But without any supplies, there's only so much she can do. And Stucky O'Maly's new hospitals won't hire her; robo nurses work for free.
entries.target: 她很想帮助你解决你的健康问题,但没有任何物资,她只能做得太多.

entries.source: She's spent many years in the hospital due to stomach complications. But fortunately for her, the man of her dreams gave her a miraculous phone call.
entries.target: 她因胃并发症住院了很多年,但幸运的是,她梦想中的男人给了她一个神奇的电话.

entries.source: He knows how to play over 5 different instruments and was known for his jazz career. After the rise of idols like Akako Yua, the general public doesn't have any interest in no-name artists like Klef.
entries.target: 他知道如何玩 5 随着像阿卡科·尤亚这样的偶像的兴起,一般人对像克莱夫这样的无名艺术家没有任何兴趣.

entries.source: The lead singer of the Coast Crabs. Many of their singles have sold over a million copies. However, he's not so enthusiastic about Bryant's newer songwriting style. . .
entries.target: 布莱恩特是"海"乐队的首席歌手.他们的许多单曲已经销售了超过百万份.

entries.source: The main songwriter of the Coast Crabs. While he may have already found success, he's still not completely satisfied with his work. There's always another boundary to push.
entries.target: 他可能已经取得了成功,但他仍然不完全满意他的工作.

entries.source: The most understated member of the Coast Crabs. He may not be a household name, but without his harmony vocals, the music just wouldn't be the same.
entries.target: 他可能不是一个家庭名字,但没有他的和歌声,音乐就不会是相同的.

entries.source: She claims the biggest wave she ever rode was 20 stories tall. But Mick knows the truth. . . It was actually 30 stories tall, and she's just being modest.
entries.target: 她声称她曾经骑过的最大波浪是 20 虽然我知道,但米克知道真相. 30 她只是谦虚的.

entries.source: The key to catching the biggest wave is knowing when to wait and when to go. According to Mick, the waves get nervous if they know you're watching, you gotta catch them off guard.
entries.target: 捕捉最大波的关键是知道什么时候等待和什么时候去. 根据米克说,波动会紧张,

entries.source: Joao always had a special connection with surfboards. When he was a child, a surfboard visited him in his dreams. It told him, @Find me, Joao. . . We'll do great things together!@ To this day, he's still looking.
entries.target: 乔阿奥一直与冲浪板有着特殊的联系. 当他小时候,一个冲浪板在他梦中访问了他. @找我,乔阿. 我们一起会做出伟大的东西!@ 他还在寻找.

entries.source: Stan may be working for a Stucky-owned business, but that doesn't mean he's just a puppet. He's changing the system from the inside, maaaaan.
entries.target: 斯坦可能是Stucky拥有的公司,但这并不意味着他是个子.

entries.source: She shops at Stucky Style because they always have the latest trends. She knows this because all the ads say so.
entries.target: 她在Stucky Style购物,因为他们总是有最新的趋势. 她知道这一点,因为所有的广告都说.

entries.source: Shark-E spent years fixing up his Gulfswagen. He takes any opportunity to take her on the road and show her off. It's just too bad Gulfswagens can't go underwater.
entries.target: 鱼-E花了多年时间修复他的Gulfswagen,他抓住任何机会,带她上路上,展示她.

entries.source: No one knows what's going on isnide of the mind of Aiden, so it's better to stay away from him; he might be dangerous.
entries.target: 没有人知道艾登的思想是什么,所以最好远离他,他可能是危险的.

entries.source: The expert at getting girls' @numbers.@ He keeps them in a giant binder organized numerically and shows them off as often as he can. His favorites are the ones with repeating digits.
entries.target: 让女孩们得到的专家 @它们是数量.@ 他把它们放在一个巨大的连接器中,按数量排列,并尽可能多地展示它们.

entries.source: Kyle loves eating pizza with the boys. But who doesn't, am I right?
entries.target: 凯尔喜欢和男孩一起吃披萨,但谁不喜欢,我对吗?

entries.source: Bo is just an average guy. He has a minimum wage job just to pay the bills, but all he really wants to do is sit at home and watch tv. He might get that wish once O'Maly's cashier drones replace him.
entries.target: 博只是一个普通人,他只能支付账单,但他真正想做的就是坐在家里看电视.

entries.source: The pickiest eater in the world. But even she wouldn't dare turn down a slice of O'Maly's Pizza!
entries.target: 世界上最挑的食者,但即使她也不敢拒绝一块奥马利的披萨!

entries.source: She decided to take a little trip to the Stucky O'Beach Strip to de-stress. But at this rate, she's going to go bankrupt with how expensive everything is.
entries.target: 她决定去"Stucky O'Beach Strip"去减轻压力,但以这种速度,她会因为一切都很昂贵而破产.

entries.source: Once he left Clay Folk Colony he never looked back. The life of luxury is what he's all about; he just needs to pull a few strings.
entries.target: 他离开了民殖民地后,他从来没有回顾过.他生活的奢是他所有,他只需要拉一些绳索.

entries.source: Frequently goes to the Stucky O'Beach Strip to spend time with his new girlfriend, Lacy. That doesn't mean he'd rather live there, though. It's just that Lacy can't exactly visit his hometown.
entries.target: 他经常去"斯塔基·奥·比奇街道"跟新女朋友拉西度过时间.这并不意味着他宁愿住在那里,只是拉西不能完全去他的家乡.

entries.source: She met Korrel when she accidentally fished him up from the water. She thought it was going to be the biggest fish ever, but no, it was just a dude--made out of clay.
entries.target: 她遇到了科雷尔,当她意外从水中捕捞他时,她以为这是有史以来最大的鱼,

entries.source: He left Shellfish Docks for the big city and got himself an apartment at SeaStucky to be where all the industry big wigs are. He hopes to one day become a famous director.
entries.target: 他离开贝类码头前往大城市，并在海斯塔基租了公寓，好接近行业大佬。他希望有朝一日能成为著名导演。

entries.source: An incredibly sunburnt man who enjoys riding the elevator way too much. And he's more than happy to share the space!
entries.target: 他太太阳烧伤了,他太喜欢乘坐电梯,他很高兴分享空间.

entries.source: She met Trish at the pervious StuckyCon and bonded with her over their shared love of Ninja Rangers. They were planning to cosplay as the main characters this year, but Brianna forgot something. . .
entries.target: 她在上届斯塔基漫展认识了特里什，两人因为都喜欢《忍者游侠》而成了朋友。她们原本计划今年扮成主角，但布丽安娜忘了一件事……

entries.source: An ancient ninja warrior sealed inside of her own clothes thousands of years ago. It was said that no one could best her in combat.
entries.target: 千年前,一个古老的忍者战士,在自己的衣服里封闭了.有人说,在战斗中,没有人能比她胜过.

entries.source: Trish loves to binge watch foreign cartoons with Brianna. When Brianna gets too tired to read the subtitles, Trish will read them aloud for her.
entries.target: 布里安娜很喜欢和布里安娜一起看外国卡通,当布里安娜太累了,无法读字幕时,

entries.source: She was scouted by the one and only Stucky O'Maly who molded her into the world's biggest idol. All her songs are lab tested by top minds to have maximum appeal and marketability.
entries.target: 她被唯一的Stucky O'Maly发现了,他塑造了她成为世界上最大的偶像.

entries.source: Akako Yua is definitely single. So you definitely wouldn't find anyone like James spending time with her during her free time.
entries.target: 亚卡科尤亚绝对是单身的,所以你绝对不会发现詹姆斯这样的人在空时光里和她在一起.

entries.source: He spends 70% of his day working out in the gym. He's too tired to move for the rest of the day, but the way he stands still like a statue really gets the girls going.
entries.target: 他花了很多钱. 70他太累了,不能在健身房里,但他像雕像一样站着,让女孩们开始动.

entries.source: Chad Crabsman doesn't really have time for women. But if women like Tonya are willing to pay enough, he supposes they can waste a bit of his precious standing time.
entries.target: 查德·克拉布斯曼对女人没有时间,但如果像托尼亚这样的女人愿意付出足够的钱,他认为他们可以浪费一些贵重的站立时间.

entries.source: The best darn swimmer in the city. But she doesn't need to go near the diving board. . . No one said you had to be a good jumper to be a good swimmer, right?
entries.target: 她是城里最厉害的游泳选手。但她可不需要靠近跳水板……谁说擅长游泳就一定得擅长跳水呢？

entries.source: He loves it when people jump off the diving board. But don't you dare do a cannonball. That's against the rules!
entries.target: 他喜欢人们跳下潜水板,但不要敢做炮球,这是违反规则的.

entries.source: She's always looking for seashells when she walks the beach. She can spend hours doing so if she's not careful. She uses her hat like a basket.
entries.target: 她在海上走路时总是寻找,如果不小心,她可以花几个小时这样做.她用帽子像篮子一样.

entries.source: Watches every football game--even the ones featuring teams he doesn't care about. But what else is there to do?
entries.target: 他看着所有的足球比赛,甚至那些他不关心的球队.

entries.source: Even though Ralph is one of the hardest workers at Stucky O Mart, he never gets the recognition he deserves. He's still underpaid and has still never been employee of the month. If only he had a better resume.
entries.target: 尽管拉尔夫是StuckyOMart最辛苦的工作人员之一,但他从来没有得到他应得的认可.他仍然低薪,而且从来没有成为月份的员工.

entries.source: Jim has been the employee of the month for four years straight. He claims to be a hard worker and model employee, however in reality he gets other employees to do his work and takes all the credit.
entries.target: 吉姆连续四年当选月度最佳员工。他自称勤奋又堪称模范，实际上却总让其他员工替他干活，再把功劳全揽到自己身上。

entries.source: This baby was sealed away inside of a chest. What great, threatening power must he possess?
entries.target: 这婴儿被封在胸前,他必须拥有什么大威脅的力量?

entries.source: The mayor of New O'Maly City. And the leader of the Gangster Goons. There's a bit of a conflict of interest there--but not for him! He's reaping all the rewards of this corruption!
entries.target: 纽约奥马利市长,以及帮派领袖,有点有利益冲突,但他没有!他收获了这个腐败的全部收益!

entries.source: Some weirdo who spends all of his time on the computer. Knows how to whistle both ways.
entries.target: 一个把时间都花在电脑上的怪物,知道如何两条方向.

entries.source: Lived his entire life in a printing shop. The abundant access to paper has given him the ability to draw well. . . Though the over exposure to ink fumes emanating from the shop may have affected his brain a bit.
entries.target: 由于他有大量的纸质,他能够很好地绘画. . . . 尽管他可能因从店内发出的墨水烟雾过度接触而有所影响他的大脑.

entries.source: Recently graduated 22nd grade with all As to get a PhD. Is a world expert in a specific kind of fungus that at least one dozen people know about. Is married, has two cats, and still remembers how to play a flute.
entries.target: 他最近以全A成绩从22年级毕业，并获得了博士学位。他是某种特定真菌的世界级专家，至少有十二个人听说过这种真菌。他已婚，养了两只猫，而且还记得怎么吹长笛。

entries.source: Unlike his brother, he believes raw power is what's most important. They haven't spoken since getting into an arguement over it. Or maybe it was about which flavor of chips was best. . .
entries.target: 他认为原油能是最重要的,因为他们一直在争论.或者是关于哪种香最好.

entries.source: Dorken has always been insecure about his appearance. All the other dinosaurs are scary while he's seen as goofy. If only he had a way to be as scary as the ghosts.
entries.target: 多尔肯一直对自己的外表缺乏自信。其他恐龙都很吓人，只有他被当成滑稽角色。要是能像幽灵一样可怕就好了。

entries.source: When he was young, Nelson thought he saw an alien spacecraft outside his bedroom window. Since then, he's been obsessed with finding aliens to prove they exist. What he saw that day was actually just a frisbee.
entries.target: 尼尔逊年轻时以为他在卧室窗外看到一个外星人飞船. 从那时起,他一直痴迷于寻找外星人来证明他们存在.

entries.source: An alien from the planet Cronot, Zunts joined the space force when he was only 10 years old. Zunts left his dying planet in hopes of finding a safer place to live.
entries.target: 特斯从克罗诺特星球的外星人加入太空部队,当时他只有 10 特斯离开了他的垂死的星球,希望找到一个更安全的地方.

entries.source: Just because he's a gnome, it doesn't mean he belongs in a garden. He DOES live in one, but that's only a coincidence.
entries.target: 只是因为他是个小子,这并不意味着他属于一个花园.

entries.source: When it gets cold, she bundles up next to a fire. This has led to multiple near-death experiences.
entries.target: 当它变冷时,她会在火旁起来,这导致了多次临死经历.

entries.source: He just found the coolest hat ever; he's become so enammored with it, he tells everyone else about it nonstop. We get it, it moves or whatever.
entries.target: 他刚找到有史以来最酷的帽子，并彻底迷上了它，逢人就没完没了地介绍。我们知道了，它会动之类的。

entries.source: Nara's always in search of the best scents. But she feels as though she's exhausted all the potential the local fungi offer.
entries.target: 奈拉总是寻找最好的香气,但她觉得她已经耗尽了当地真菌提供的潜力.

entries.source: He hates the Steely Scavengers for what they've done to the environment. That technology they revived should have stayed dormant.
entries.target: 他恨斯斯蒂利挖掘者,因为他们对环境所做的.

entries.source: Knowledgeable about all things fungi, Vepris is willing to talk to anyone about them for hours. Just don't bring up that @woo-woo@ nonsense.
entries.target: 维普里斯知道各种各样的真菌,他愿意几个小时与任何人谈论它们. @,,@ 没有什么意思.

entries.source: She should be concerned about the Steely Scavengers potentially trying to harm her. But they're just too cool to hate. They're robo dinosaurs, dangit!
entries.target: 她应该担心SteelyScavengers可能会伤害她,但他们太酷了,不能恨他们.

entries.source: Notaris knows a special method of creating extremely potent potions. But the spores required are difficult to retrieve. . .
entries.target: 专注人员知道一种特殊的方法来制造极其强大的药物.

entries.source: He's afraid of the stories the older gnomes tell of the vicious attack 50 years ago. That's why he won't hestitate to kill anything that threatens their home now.
entries.target: 他害怕老们讲述的关于恶意袭击的故事 50 这就是为什么他不敢杀死任何威胁他们的家.

entries.source: He was around back when Thorn first fell into the oasis; however, he was still a kid at the time. Thorn became known as the @child of the sky@ and was then raised by the gnomes.
entries.target: 他在后面,当棘第一次落在绿洲;然而,他当时还是一个小孩子.棘被称为 @天上的孩子@ 然后被虫抚养.

entries.source: Alni was killed during the vicious attack on Oasis Garden 50 years ago. But he's left with one lingering regret: the fact that he never got to try the mythical golden mushroom.
entries.target: 艾尔尼在奥阿斯花园的凶残袭击中被杀 50 他离开了,但他仍然抱着一个遗憾:他没有尝试神话般的金色.

entries.source: You think all these items are worthless? Trust me, there are people willing to buy everything. And Duke knows how to sell it to them.
entries.target: 你认为这些东西都没有价值吗?相信我,有愿意买一切的人. 杜克知道如何向他们卖.

entries.source: His dad put him in charge of retrieving the special spores they use for potions in order to make him more confident. But what does it matter if he still gets help from others. . .
entries.target: 他父亲让他负责检索他们用作药物的特殊物,以使他更加自信.

entries.source: Unlike Mollug, he wasn't actually told to help retrieve anything. But he tags along because the danger and thrills excite him.
entries.target: 他不像莫卢格一样,他没有被要求帮助搜回任何东西,但他随身,因为危险和兴奋激动他.

entries.source: Stan taught Thorn how to fend for herself when she was young. Unlike the gnomes, he offered her a path to something greater in the dog-eat-dog world of The Dreadlands. Morality was another matter, however.
entries.target: 斯坦教了托恩在年轻时如何为自己提供养分.与小行星不同,他在"恐惧国"的狗吃狗世界里为她提供了更大的道路.

entries.source: A member of the Crusty Crooks. Xankulos caught Seth stealing rocks from the clay folk and put him in jail. This event has scared Seth into possibly quitting the Crusty Crooks.
entries.target: 克桑古洛斯抓住塞斯从泥土人那里偷石头,把他送进监狱.

entries.source: Xankulos put Eeoker in jail for shooting a bubble at an old farmer. Eeoker is a primian ninja with a decently high rank, but no one can evade the judgment of Lord Xankulos.
entries.target: 克洛斯把克拉送入监狱,因为他向老农民射击了泡.克拉是一个高等级的克拉,

entries.source: A hotheaded adventurer who weilds a sword of flames. He left his grandpa and little sister to travel the world with Hikari and Haruka in hopes of finding his estranged father and becoming the strongest warrior.
entries.target: 他离开了他的祖父和小姐姐,去旅行世界与海卡里和哈鲁卡,希望找到他疏远的父亲,成为最强大的战士.

entries.source: A descendant of royalty, she ran away from her family after they became chaotic. She weilds a magical bow and arrow to fight the Steely Scavengers with Ton and Haruka.
entries.target: 她是王室后裔,在他们的混乱之后,她逃离了她的家人.她用一个神奇的弓箭与箭来与和哈鲁卡一起战斗钢铁挖掘者.

entries.source: Despite her laid-back nature, she's quite skilled with a bo staff. She joined Ton and Hikari on their adventures because she just wanted friends. Ultimately they were all captured by Xankulos for being rowdy.
entries.target: 尽管她很平静,但她很熟练地使用工作人员.她加入了和海卡里在他们的冒险中,因为她只是想有朋友.

entries.source: The son of Mr. Bear, Jr. looks up to his father and hopes to one day be as brave as him. He will inherit the position of clan leader once the time has come. . . and it could be sooner than he thinks.
entries.target: 小熊先生是熊先生的儿子，他崇拜父亲，希望有天能和父亲一样勇敢。时机成熟时，他将继承族长之位……而这一天可能比他想象得更早。

entries.source: Xankulos put Mrs. Bear and the other members of the bear family in jail as punishment for their clan guarding his chest for generations. Mrs. Bear holds no grudge against the person who released Xankulos.
entries.target: 赞库洛斯把熊夫人和熊家族其他成员关进监狱，以惩罚他们一族世代守护他的宝箱。熊夫人并不怨恨释放赞库洛斯的人。

entries.source: Elder Bear was the leader of the Bear clan for 20 years before he passed down that honor to his son, Mr. Bear. Elder Bear was out picking berries with Bear Jr. and Mrs. Bear when Xankulos was released.
entries.target: 熊老是熊族的领导者 20 长熊和小熊和小熊女士一起去果,当库洛斯被释放时.

entries.source: Jaclyn never spends time with the other angels. She'd rather watch whatever's on tv. But with Xankulos back, it's now her job to broadcast his court cases to let the world know how to behave.
entries.target: 杰奎琳从不和其他天使来往，更愿意看电视。赞库洛斯归来后，她负责转播他的庭审，让全世界知道该如何守规矩。

entries.source: Stripped of power, this is what Xankulos really looks like. He was extremely lucky to be chosen as the ordained judge all those years ago. What did the angels see in him. . . ?
entries.target: 由于被剥夺权力,古洛斯真的是这样看起来.他非常幸运,多年前被选为任命的法官.

entries.source: Commonly viewed as pests. What they lack in intelligence, they more than make up for in persistence. After all, they are the oldest of all extant lifeforms.
entries.target: 它们是人类最古老的生物,它们的智力也能补偿它们的坚持性.

entries.source: These glaries are particularly attuned to their surroundings and are quick to turn around if a sheer drop is detected. What goes up does not in fact need to come down.
entries.target: 这些光线特别适合周围环境,如果发现有落,它们会很快转回.

entries.source: Glaries that have developed the ability to cling to surfaces. Because they no longer have the means to move freely, they sustain themselves by sucking in nearby insects.
entries.target: 由于它们不再有自由的移动手段,因此它们通过吸收附近的昆虫来维持自身的生存.

entries.source: A glarey that has been possessed by one of Xankulos' evil orbs. Its power, and size, have increased dramatically. Its only purpose now is to serve Xankulos in his new reign.
entries.target: 一只被赞库洛斯的邪恶球体附身的格莱里。它的力量和体型都大幅增长。如今它唯一的目的，就是在赞库洛斯的新统治下为他效力。

entries.source: Primians that have never skipped leg day. They earn their red headbands once they're able to jump at least 5 feet high.
entries.target: 那些从来没有跳过腿日的初级生,一旦他们能够跳起,就能得到他们的红色头带. 5 高一英尺.

entries.source: If you hear a rustling in the trees, it's likely a branch dweller. If their ambush from above isn't successful, their last resort is to look scary. And look scary they do.
entries.target: 如果从上方的伏击未能成功,他们最后的手段就是看起来可怕.

entries.source: Snake-like creatures that reside in forests or high altitude areas. It may seem like they're constantly spitting projectiles for self-defense, but actually they do it for their own amusement.
entries.target: 它们可能会看起来像他们不断地用弹药来自卫,但实际上它们是为了自己的娱乐.

entries.source: These fish aren't very particular when it comes to what they eat, so if they smell anything above the water, they'll jump up to take a bite. Beige glaries commonly meet their end in this way.
entries.target: 它们在食物方面并不特别,所以如果它们闻到水上任何东西,它们会跳起来吃一口.

entries.source: Primians who don the green headbands have completely overcome their fear of heights. Now, instead, they're deathly afraid of the ground.
entries.target: 穿着绿色头带的初始人已经完全克服了高处的恐惧.

entries.source: Spores are released every time their eyes are opened. While these spores are harmful to others, their main purpose is to propagate more funguseyes.
entries.target: 每当它们睁开眼睛，就会释放孢子。这些孢子会伤害其他生物，但主要用途是繁殖出更多菌眼怪。

entries.source: Nobody likes this guy. He's incredibly annoying and just doesn't know when to quit it with the slingshot. Look, man, it actually hurts!
entries.target: 没有人喜欢这个人,他很烦人,他不知道什么时候停止.

entries.source: Ruby Glaries expel waste through a duct on their forehead. Yep, that's one more reason to dodge their attacks.
entries.target: 布里斯通过额头的管道排出废物.

entries.source: Red glaries have microscopic suction cups at the ends of their legs which allow them to walk on anything. Additionally, their tough helmets make them more resilient than the average glarey.
entries.target: 红色格莱里的腿端长着微型吸盘，因此可以在任何表面行走。此外，它们坚硬的头盔也让其比普通格莱里更耐打。

entries.source: These glaries produce helium using a special gland in order to float in the air. When left amongst themselves, they can be heard making high-pitched sounds and laughing.
entries.target: 这些光通过一种特殊的腺体来产生气,以便在空中浮动.

entries.source: Primians with white headbands have mastered the art of tossing stuff. What stuff, exactly. . . ? Any stuff within reach.
entries.target: 那些带着白色头带的原始人已经掌握了扔东西的艺术.

entries.source: Every primian can produce bubbles from their mouths, but only those who don the blue headbands have the stamina to do so multiple times without needing to rehydrate.
entries.target: 每个普里米安人都能从口中吐出泡泡，但只有系蓝色头带的个体才有足够体力连续发射，无需停下补充水分。

entries.source: A slither that has been possessed by one of Xankulos' evil orbs. Its power, and size, have increased dramatically. It now has the ability to spit up exploding eggs, and stretch its tongue over 20 feet.
entries.target: 克卢斯的邪恶球体之一拥有的滑鼠.它的力量和大小,已经大幅增加.它现在有能力吐出爆炸的蛋, 20 脚.

entries.source: These birds have impeccable aim; once they set their sights on a target, it's likely getting smacked. So try not to be the target.
entries.target: 这些鸟类的目标是无可挑,一旦他们把目光定向目标,它可能会被击中.

entries.source: An advanced form of the orange glaries. With three launchers now, their attacking capabilities are three-fold.
entries.target: 现在有三枚发射器,他们的攻击能力是三倍的.

entries.source: All swimsters wanna do is swim. So if they manage to hurt you, you probably shouldn't have been in their personal space.
entries.target: 如果他们能伤害你,你可能不应该在他们的私人空间.

entries.source: Purple glaries are far more aggressive than their green counterparts. They actively attack anyone who goes near them with energy blasts.
entries.target: 紫色的光比绿色的光更具侵略性,它们会激烈地攻击任何接近它们的人.

entries.source: Unlike their green cousins, red slithers are more deliberate with their attacks. What's more, their attacks are many degrees hotter and more dangerous.
entries.target: 红色滑鼠与绿色表兄弟不同,更有意义地攻击.

entries.source: These mysterious creatures seem to exist soley to produce and release their signature spiky protrusions. But beyond their exposed body exists a complex network of hyphae.
entries.target: 这些神秘生物似乎只为制造并释放标志性的尖刺突起而存在。然而在它们裸露的身体之下，还藏着复杂的菌丝网络。

entries.source: These amphibians wrap their tongues around their bodies in order to regulate body tempurature. And they wrap their tongues around you in order to regulate hunger.
entries.target: 这些两栖动物把舌头缠在身上来调节体温；它们把舌头缠住你，则是为了解决饥饿。

entries.source: When hoptungs are fully hydrated they turn violet and gain the ability to spew excess moisture for self-defense. Actually, they'll even do it for offense.
entries.target: 子完全化后,会变得紫色, 为了自卫而吐出过多的水分.

entries.source: When a red primian levels up their skills they're able to become super red primians. They can perform a super jump into a super kick with ease, but they don't have the greatest aim.
entries.target: 红色的子可以轻松跳进一个超级子,但它们没有最大的目标.

entries.source: Chuko is the current leader of the Primian Ninjas. He eats so many chili peppers that he's able to shoot fire from his mouth.
entries.target: 楚科是原始忍者领导者,他吃了这么多,他能从嘴里射出火.

entries.source: Purple headbands are given to primians who have great upper strength. They're short tempered and love to thrash about.
entries.target: 紫色头带是给了那些具有强度的普里米亚人.

entries.source: Smonkith dons the coveted golden headband. He's able to produce bubbles faster and with better aim than a blue primian. He can also jump higher and has greater strength than red or purple primians respectively.
entries.target: 斯蒙基斯戴着金色头带.他能够比蓝色子更快地和更好的目标地产生泡.他也可以跳得更高,并且比红色子或紫色子更强.

entries.source: Before one can ask the Mother Stalk to grant a wish, they must first endure her inevitable @morning fury.@ Not many have been able to actually make a wish. . .
entries.target: 在一个人可以要求满足愿望之前,他们必须先忍受她的不可避免 @晨间的愤怒.@ 许多人没有真正愿意. . .

entries.source: These crabs don't have a single care in the world. Which means they also don't care if they happen to poke you with one of their claws. It's better to keep your distance.
entries.target: 这些虫在世界上没有一个关心,这意味着他们也不在乎如果他们碰巧用他们的爪子你.

entries.source: Seabites store energy in their stomach and need to release it at least once an hour. The most effective way to dispose of the built-up energy is to fire it at their enemies.
entries.target: 海洋生物在胃里储存能量,每小时至少一次需要释放能量.

entries.source: Tan glaries have small weighted ball bearings inside their bodies which allow them to spin fast enough to glide for a short time.
entries.target: 色的光体内有小的重量球轴承,使它们能够快速旋转,

entries.source: This type of glarey is very similar to the tan variety except they are rather territorial. They stay in one spot to defend their territory with the energy they collect while spinning.
entries.target: 它们的色与色类型非常相似,但它们是相当领土的.它们保持在一个位置,以保护它们的领土,以它们在旋转时收集的能量.

entries.source: These aren't your average clownfish; the silly splashers have somehow grown to excessive sizes. It may be due to the water.
entries.target: 它们不是普通的小丑鱼, 它们的鱼已经变得过大了.

entries.source: The spiky, heat-seeking projectiles of the octospiker are each inbued with a small portion of their brain cells. Thus, older octospikers are naturally less intelligent.
entries.target: 八子的尖,热量探测弹器中,每个都含有其脑细胞的小部分.因此,老八子自然是不那么聪明的.

entries.source: Mindlessly swimming underwater or flopping around on land is about the only thing fishy flops do. They're pretty much the bottom of the food chain in these waters.
entries.target: 鱼只能在水下游泳或在陆上鱼,它们几乎是这些水域的食物链底部.

entries.source: These piranhas have been reproducing at an accelerated rate recently, and now they're endangering the local fish population. And to make it worse, they don't even taste good.
entries.target: 现在他们危及了当地鱼群, 更糟糕的是,它们甚至不味道好.

entries.source: The swift piranhas are able to swim faster by manipulating gravitational forces with their quantum glands. From their perspective it's YOU who's going fast.
entries.target: 快速的海豚通过操纵量子腺体来游泳更快.从他们的角度来看,你是快速的.

entries.source: Using psychic energy, the alpha piranhas can manipulate smaller fish of other species which they then use as a defensive barrier.
entries.target: 阿尔法食人鱼能用精神力量操纵其他物种的小鱼，再让这些鱼充当防御屏障。

entries.source: Besides flying around in circles, flutter parrots also enjoy chitchatting. Usually their conversations devolve into who is the prettiest bird.
entries.target: 蝶除了环绕飞行,还喜欢聊.通常,他们的谈话是关于哪个鸟是最漂亮的.

entries.source: Pelidrops eat an excessive number of fishy flops. . . So many that they need to spit one out every so often so they can breathe.
entries.target: 鱼吃了大量的鱼. . . . 它们需要经常吐出一鱼,以便呼吸.

entries.source: The spitfish is likely the most annoying creature in the sea. Local fisherman have reportedly been knocked into the water, only to hear, @It's just a prank!@ as they struggle ashore.
entries.target: 据报道,当地渔民被击落, @这只是一个玩笑!@ 他们在岸上扎.

entries.source: Rumors circulated in the past of @mysterious sea monsters@ that lived in the ocean. This annoyed the nesso, who became much more violent as a result: After all, who likes being the subject of rumors?
entries.target: 过去流行的谣言 @神秘的海怪@ 尼索人,因为这些事,变得更加暴力:毕竟,谁喜欢成为谣言的主题?

entries.source: Learning to swallow a sword is a skill most shouldn't even attempt to master. But these primians didn't stop there; they've mastered the ability to store countless swords to call upon at any time.
entries.target: 掌握剑是一项技能,大多数人甚至不应该试图掌握. 但这些普里米亚人并没有停下来;他们掌握了随时使用无数剑的能力.

entries.source: These are primians who were barely able to make the cut when applying for the Primian Pirates crew. When asked to wield a sword, they nearly sunk the ship. . . but they could at least say, @Arrrgg!@
entries.target: 那些几乎没有成功的普里米亚海盗队员,当他们被要求携带剑时,他们几乎淹没了船只, @! !@

entries.source: These primians can hit their targets with a stunning accuracy of 90%! It could potentially reach 100% if they were willing to take off their giant hats, but that's an unacceptable trade-off.
entries.target: 这些原始人可以以惊人的精度击中目标 90它们可能会达到 100如果他们愿意脱掉他们的巨头帽子,但这是一个不可接受的交易.

entries.source: In order to become quartermaster, a primian must first demonstrate their absolute loyalty to Captain Shuko. This usually amounts to handing over all of their jewels.
entries.target: 为了成为四分之一大师, 一个普里米亚人必须首先向苏科船长表现出绝对忠诚.

entries.source: Shell slugs with the ability to shoot rocks from the tips of their shells. These rocks are actually formed from sediment that's picked up while crawling along surfaces.
entries.target: 它们可以从顶射石头.这些石头实际上是由爬行表面收集的沉积物组成的.

entries.source: The brother of Chuko, Shuko wasn't about the ninja life. He gathered up a crew of primians and set sail as the captain of the Primian Pirates. He has mastered the art of spitting boomerang swords.
entries.target: 朱科的兄弟,舒科不是关于忍者生活. 他聚集了一个小组的小组人,并作为小组海盗的船长出海. 他掌握了吐金剑的艺术.

entries.source: Although these creatures are quite large, they are filled with helium which allows them to stay on top of the water despite their size.
entries.target: 尽管这些生物体型庞大，体内却充满氦气，所以即使这么大也能浮在水面。

entries.source: The shells on these shell slugs have grown so large that it stops them from being able to crawl on the ceiling. Their shells are also pretty easy to knock off.
entries.target: 它们的子已经变得如此大,以至于它们无法爬上天花板.

entries.source: Jelly glaries are experts at ruining vacations. If they detect a child entering the ocean for the very first time, they swim as fast as they can just to make sure their legs get stung.
entries.target: 果果是破坏假期的专家.如果他们第一次发现一个孩子进入海洋,

entries.source: Sharpunches swim through the water exclusively by flexing. This allows their muscles to grow large enough to power the strongest punches.
entries.target: 鱼只通过曲游泳,这使得它们的肌肉变得足够大,以供最强的击.

entries.source: Often in packs of 3, the dartfish use their pointy noses to spear anything they can. Whatever they catch, they eat--which usually ends up being fishy flops.
entries.target: 通常在包装中 3它们用尖的鼻子射出任何东西.

entries.source: Marinians are the product of a divergant primian evolution many years in the past. This is why they share a love for throwing objects at others.
entries.target: 海洋生物是多年前的不同式的原始进化产物,

entries.source: These glaries are too durable to defeat. . . Or so it seems. Some say if you pierce them with a sharp enough object, they CAN be knocked out.
entries.target: 那些光的光太耐用了,无法击败. . . .或者看起来是这样.有人说,如果你用足够尖的物体穿过它们,它们就会被击中.

entries.source: Flamingos can't help but put on a show when others are around. The fact that their performances involve sharp and deadly feathers isn't a concern for them.
entries.target: 周围有观众时，火烈鸟总忍不住要表演。至于表演中会用到尖锐致命的羽毛，它们一点也不在乎。

entries.source: Some crustatians don't want to join the civilized world and reject things like clothing. Being a part of the crusty crooks allows them to be @free.@
entries.target: 某些地人不想加入文明世界,拒绝服装等东西. @没有任何东西.@

entries.source: The eyes of lotl-cannons are so sensitive that they tend to keep them closed. The only reason they're ever open is to fire their plasma orbs with maximum precision.
entries.target: 洛特尔炮怪的眼睛极其敏感，因此通常紧闭双眼。只有需要以最高精度发射等离子球时，它们才会睁眼。

entries.source: An armorshell that has been possessed by one of Xankulos' evil orbs. Its power, and size, have increased dramatically. It now has the ability to fire projectiles from its impenetrable shell.
entries.target: 克卢斯的邪恶球体拥有了这颗甲.它的力量和大小已经大幅增加.它现在能够从不可穿透的甲中射射弹.

entries.source: The only thing worse than a sharpunch is a sharpunch with a pointy nose! Be careful because if they pass you up, they always follow their noses back to you.
entries.target: 比尖冲鱼更糟的，只有长着尖鼻子的尖冲鱼！千万小心，它们一旦冲过你身边，总会循着鼻子再找回来。

entries.source: This shell slug is always angry. It's so angry that if anyone were to knock off its shell it makes sure to get revenge by chasing after them.
entries.target: 这颗子总是生气,它是如此生气,如果有人打掉了它的子,它会通过追赶他们来报复.

entries.source: Thorn will do anything for the sake of what she thinks is right--even if that means fighting you! And with the power of her @sacred helmet,@ she can increase her movement speed, so watch out!
entries.target: 棘会为她认为是正确的做任何事情,即使这意味着与你作战! @圣帽子,@ 她可以提高运动速度,所以要注意!

entries.source: Much like the red glarey, the pink glarey has a helmet growth on its head. The pink glarey's helmet has formed into a cone which allows it to balance like a top.
entries.target: 和红色格莱里一样，粉色格莱里头上也长着头盔。它的头盔形成锥形，让它能像陀螺一样保持平衡。

entries.source: The jaws of the Wave Gator can open wide enough to consume most of what happens to enter. Not everything that finds its way inside is @edible,@ but the wave gator couldn't care less.
entries.target: 波的口可以开得足够宽,以消耗进入的大部分. @食物可食用,@ 但波子也没什么事.

entries.source: Spotted flinglings have a symbiotic relationship with the local starfish, who couldn't be happier being used as projectiles.
entries.target: 斑点飞翎与当地海星形成了共生关系，而海星们很乐意被当作投射物使用。

entries.source: Spinning is about the only thing star-spinners have going for them. They can withstand spinning upwards of 230 miles per hour.
entries.target: 旋转是恒星旋转者唯一的目标. 230 千里/小时.

entries.source: Storkers have an extremely low IQ. In some cultures, being called a @storker@ is perhaps the harshest insult one could receive.
entries.target: 鱼的智商非常低. @鱼@ 也许是最严重的侮辱.

entries.source: Bubble crusters use the bubbles they spit up to polish their shells until they become a shiny golden color. Not very many crustatians are capable of producing such potent bubbles.
entries.target: 泡使用它们吐出的泡,磨它们的子,直到它们变得闪闪发光的金色.

entries.source: Once every generation a crustatian grows over 50 feet tall and becomes the @King Cruster.@ The current king founded the Crusty Crooks and abandoned the peaceful crustatians.
entries.target: 每一代都会有一次生长. 50 高,成为 @克拉斯特王.@ 现在的国王创立了鱼鱼,

entries.source: The bright, shining antenna of this fish is the perfect tool to lure unsuspecting fishy flops to their doom. However, it only serves to frighten more sentient prey by illuminating the creature's toothy grin.
entries.target: 这种鱼明亮闪耀的触须，是引诱毫无防备的小鱼走向毁灭的绝佳工具。然而面对更有智慧的猎物，它只会照亮生物满是利齿的笑脸，把对方吓跑。

entries.source: Glubbo possesses many incredible combat skills, including but not limited to: firing plasma orbs, stomping around like a maniac, and performing a somersault that would put any professional wrestler to shame.
entries.target: 格布博拥有许多令人难以置信的战斗技能,包括但不限于:射击血球, 身像疯子,

entries.source: These statues were built many years ago by the angels to better protect their secluded land. Even now, well after the angels have relocated, the sentinels continue protecting their abandoned domain.
entries.target: 许多年前,天使们建造了这些雕像,以更好地保护他们偏远的土地.

entries.source: Much like the angel it was crafted in the image of, this statue has a rather short temper. It posseses a wide assortment of defensive abilities with which to expel unwanted invaders.
entries.target: 这座雕像像像被造像天使一样,它很短暂,它拥有各种防御能力,

entries.source: Cobalt glaries are very similar to their ruby counterparts but due to them living in the city they've managed to level up their jumping abilities to dodge cars.
entries.target: 光很像他们的流石同行,但由于他们生活在城市,

entries.source: A rank-and-file agent of the Gangster Goons. Even they don't know who exactly is calling the shots, but they'll follow the orders all the same.
entries.target: 黑帮打手的普通特工。就连他们自己也不知道究竟是谁在发号施令，却照样会执行命令。

entries.source: Some members of the primian ninjas have moved to the big city and joined the Gangster Goons. Instead of throwing rocks, they've upgraded to using grenades.
entries.target: 那些前忍者搬到大城市,加入了帮派,而不是扔石头,他们升级到使用手榴弹.

entries.source: Indigo glaries have managed to maintain their legs even after developing launching orifices. This makes them quite a threat for the average city goer.
entries.target: 印戈鱼在发射孔后也能保持腿部,这使得它们对一般城市游客来说是一个威胁.

entries.source: The Gangster Goons have stolen so many cars that it's safer to assume ANY vehicle is a threat. They modify the cars, too, by removing the brakes. Now THAT'S dangerous.
entries.target: 帮派们偷了这么多的汽车,更安全地假设任何车辆都是威胁. 他们也通过取消车来修改汽车.

entries.source: The Gangster Goons never obey the law. That's why they make sure to go above the speed limit as often as they can.
entries.target: 帮派们从来没有遵守法律,所以他们尽可能过度超越速度限制.

entries.source: Red tacklers are retired football players who have joined the Gangster Goons. They may not be as fast as they used to be, but their tackles still pack a punch.
entries.target: 红色球员是退休的足球运动员,他们加入了帮派球队.他们可能不像以前那么快,

entries.source: Stucky Corp produces many different drones for many different purposes. This type, for example, is designed to shoot at people. The company swears it's a necessary feature.
entries.target: 果公司生产了许多不同的无人机,用于许多不同的目的.例如,这种类型,是用来射击人们.

entries.source: These drones are designed to target anyone attempting to steal from Stucky Corp's facilities. For some reason, the Gangster Goons had no trouble acquiring and reprogramming them for their own means.
entries.target: 这些无人机专门瞄准试图从斯塔基公司设施中偷窃的人。不知为何，黑帮打手毫不费力地弄到了它们，并重新编程为己所用。

entries.source: When multiple Goons ride in the same car, you know they mean business. With one behind the wheel, the other is free to use their giant blaster weapon.
entries.target: 很多子在同一辆车上,你知道他们很有意义,一个在车轮后,另一个可以使用他们的巨大的弹药武器.

entries.source: These Goons enjoy the open air as they ride along. They also enjoy popping a wheelie at just the right time to smash your face in.
entries.target: 那些子在开放空中骑着,也喜欢在正确的时间上车,

entries.source: Green tacklers have ascended beyond football and have joined the Gangster Goons to test their true power. They love to tackle birds in the air when they jump.
entries.target: 绿色的手已经超越足球,加入了帮派子来测试他们的真正力量.

entries.source: These Goons are experts in anything and everything dealing with chains. You need a pulley system set up or a car lifted? Call the chain expert.
entries.target: 那些子是任何东西和一切的专家,处理链. 你需要安装一个杆系统或一个车?

entries.source: Glaries that have developed numerous launching orifices in addition to helium levitation. They're truly a fearsome bunch.
