entries.target: 光器除了升外,还开发了许多发射孔.

entries.source: Crimson glaries enjoy jumping from platform to platform. They actually have to jump to move around as they've forgotten how to crawl.
entries.target: 色的光喜欢从平台到平台跳跃,他们必须跳跃,因为他们忘记了爬行.

entries.source: Spike drones are designed to surprise intruders at the last second by emerging beneath them. It would be a big problem if they were ever, for some reason, hidden throughout the entire city.
entries.target: 尖刺无人机会在最后一刻从入侵者脚下冒出，打对方一个措手不及。如果它们莫名其妙地被藏遍整座城市，那就麻烦大了。

entries.source: Hammer experts know a thing or two about hammers. They've all been trained in the art of hammer throwing so they can hit a nail from ten stories high.
entries.target: 锤子专家对锤子了如指掌。他们都受过抛锤训练，能从十层楼高处准确命中一枚钉子。

entries.source: These Gangster Goons have souped up their cars with the finest propulsion technologies. It must be fun rocketing through the air; who cares whether there's a place to land?
entries.target: 这些帮派们用最好的推进技术起了他们的车辆. 飞行在空中一定是有趣的.

entries.source: These drones from Stucky Corp are designed to deliver packages to customers. However, the Gangster Goons have retrofitted some of them to instead deliver rabid glaries.
entries.target: 尽管这些机器被设计成为客户送送包裹,但帮派们已经改装了一些机器,

entries.source: Jackhammers are everything to these Goons. They're so skilled with them, they even use the jackhammers for transportation--and occasionally for fun!
entries.target: 子对这些子来说都是一切的,他们非常熟练,他们甚至用子来运输,有时也为了娱乐!

entries.source: Even the local thugs have started to join the Gangster Goons. Wrench thugs used to use their wrenches to steal car engines, but now they like busting the city fire hydrants.
entries.target: 就连当地混混也开始加入黑帮打手。扳手混混过去会用扳手偷汽车引擎，如今更喜欢砸坏城里的消防栓。

entries.source: The thugs used to stand against the system, but the leader of the Gangster Goons made them an offer they couldn't refuse. So much for their principles. . .
entries.target: 那些暴徒曾经反对这个制度,但暴徒的领导人给他们一个不拒绝的报价.

entries.source: Ted just can't catch a break. He managed to break out of jail, but now everyone is trying to break him--even some @Leaf@ kid and his friends!
entries.target: 泰德只是不能抓住一个休息. 他成功逃脱监狱,但现在每个人都试图打破他--甚至一些 @叶子@ 孩子和他的朋友!

entries.source: The authorities were quick to embrace Stucky O'Maly's new administration. Curiously, they have no interest in quelling the violence that now takes place--rather, they simply add to it.
entries.target: 奇怪的是,他们没有兴趣镇压现场暴力,而是只是增加它.

entries.source: These glaries have the ability to control the helium levels in their bodies to allow them to move side to side. As they release the helium, they give off a sweet scent of bubblegum.
entries.target: 它们可以控制它们身体中的水平,使它们能够向后移动.

entries.source: These turtles have lived in the sewers for decades and in that time their shells have mutated and have become flat. Maybe it's so they can fit into the sewer pipes?
entries.target: 鱼已经生活在污水管道里几十年,而在那段时间里,它们的子已经变化,变得平坦.

entries.source: A Goon agent that has been possessed by one of Xankulos' evil orbs. his power, and size, have increased dramatically. He now has the ability to dual wield laser guns.
entries.target: 克卢斯的邪恶球体所占据的古恩特工,他的力量和规模大幅增加,他现在有能力使用双手激光枪.

entries.source: Blue tacklers are football players at their prime. They quit the league to lend their talents to the Gangster Goons.
entries.target: 蓝色的手是最盛行的足球运动员,他们离开了联赛,借助他们的才能给了帮派子.

entries.source: You'd be better off catching a train than hailing this cab. The Goons have souped up these taxis' hydraulics to an absurd amount. Watch out below!
entries.target: 与其拦这辆出租车，不如去赶火车。打手们把这些出租车的液压系统改得夸张至极。小心头顶！

entries.source: With an idol as big as Akako Yua you have to expect impersonators. . . but not like this! These dastardly Goons use her music to attack innocent people.
entries.target: 像阿卡科·尤亚这样的偶像,你必须期待模仿者...但不是这样!

entries.source: Gangster Goons disguised as surfers are a real bummer, dude! Catching a wave is easy when you have a board that rides the wind--courtesy of Stucky Corp!
entries.target: 抓住波浪很容易,当你有一个板上风的 - - 礼貌的Stucky Corp!

entries.source: These Goons mimic real cashiers by looking extremely frustrated. Then they get you with the exploding produce when you least expect it!
entries.target: 这些子模仿真实的收银员,看起来非常丧,然后他们会让你在你最不想到的时候拿出爆炸产品!

entries.source: Wearing the latest low-price fashion to blend in, these Goons pose as mannequins to catch innocent shoppers off guard.
entries.target: 穿上最新的低价时尚,这些子扮演着模特,

entries.source: These Goons have trained their bodies to stay perfectly still and can go without food for many hours, all to trick unsuspecting shoppers.
entries.target: 这些子训练了自己的身体, 保持完美的静止, 并且可以不吃饭多个小时,

entries.source: The most advanced type of mass-produced drone that Stucky Corp has yet developed. Their magnetized piston legs allow them to crawl even on the ceilings.
entries.target: 斯塔基公司目前开发的最先进量产无人机。它们的活塞腿带有磁性，甚至能在天花板上爬行。

entries.source: The personal drone of Stucky O'Maly, the SN-78 Drone V3 was the latest in drone technology. While it was equipped with top-of-the-line weaponry, it was mostly used to bring Stucky his coffee.
entries.target: 作为斯塔基·奥马利的私人无人机，SN-78 Drone V3曾是最新的无人机技术结晶。虽然配备了顶级武器，它大多时候只用来给斯塔基送咖啡。

entries.source: A glarey that has been resurrected by dark magic. In such a lawless land, even the laws of life and death may not apply. Talk about unsettling!
entries.target: 黑暗魔术使一个光的人复活了.在这样一个无法之地,甚至生命和死亡的法律也许不适用.

entries.source: In The Dreadlands, some glaries have developed more violent ways of dealing with threats, such as the ability to emit scorching flames. It might be a good idea to finally develop legs, too.
entries.target: 在"恐惧国"中,一些光者已经开发出了更暴力的方式来应对威胁,例如发射灼热的火焰的能力.

entries.source: Since being resurrected, you would assume that it no longer can fly, considering the lack of fully formed wings. But all logic goes out the window when you're dealing with dark magic!
entries.target: 既然复活了,你会认为它不能飞行了,因为它没有完全形成的翅膀.

entries.source: The slitherpedes are similar to slithers, their distant cousins, but one difference is certain: they're a heck of a lot scarier! They're even scared of each other, raising many questions about their propagation.
entries.target: 滑动脚跟滑动脚类似于滑动脚,它们的遥远表兄弟,但有一种不同是肯定的:它们更可怕!它们甚至害怕彼此,

entries.source: The pantherasaurs rule The Dreadlands! However, there's a younger crop of tech-obsessed dinos who threaten this hierarchy. Still, the pantherasaurs remain firm: a bone is all you really need!
entries.target: 虽然有年轻的科技痴迷的恐龙威胁着这个等级,但鱼仍然坚定:你真正需要的就是骨头!

entries.source: The fish of The Dreadlands grow to much larger sizes than in other regions. But they can only swim in lava or in sand; water causes them to break out in embarrasing rashes.
entries.target: 恐惧之地的鱼远比其他地区的同类巨大，但它们只能在熔岩或沙中游动；一碰到水就会长出难看的皮疹。

entries.source: Bone crusters are likely unaware that they aren't regular crusters anymore. It changes nothing about their @take life as it comes@ attitude--or is it @take death as it comes@?
entries.target: 骨可能不知道它们不再是普通的骨. @随着生命的来临@ 态度,或者是 @随着死亡的来临,@?

entries.source: These glaries are essential to the formation of sand in the region. Small glands around their bodies break down even the largest of stones, changing them into new sand masses for their swimming pleasure.
entries.target: 这些光是该地区的沙子形成的必不可少,它们身边的小腺体甚至会破碎最大的石头,从而使它们成为新的沙子,以供游泳者享受.

entries.source: These silly splashers aren't so silly anymore, are they? Sadly, with their life gone, so too is their sense of humor. They can hear even the best joke, and they will not laugh. Not even a smirk.
entries.target: 那些愚蠢的子,他们不再如此愚蠢了,他们不是吗?不幸的是,他们的生活已经消失了,他们的幽默感也一样.他们听到最好的笑话,他们不会笑.甚至不会笑.

entries.source: Dark indigo glaries fire projectiles at roughly twice the rate of their nicer counterparts. You can see it in their eyes: they only intend to kill.
entries.target: 黑色印戈的射击速度大约是其较好的同行的两倍.

entries.source: Fearing for their lives, the compies are always on the run. And if you're in the way, they'll run right into you! Exactly where they're all headed, no one knows.
entries.target: 害怕生命,同伙们总是逃跑,如果你在路上,他们会直接撞到你.

entries.source: With no more rules to follow, these glaries have engorged themselves beyond reason. After midnight? Perfect time for another slice of cake: who's gonna tell them otherwise in this lawless land!
entries.target: 没有规则,这些光已经超越理性.午夜后? 完美时间再做蛋糕:谁会告诉他们不一样的这个无法之地!

entries.source: With The Dreadlands in such a violent state, demons finally feel comfortable enough to rise to the surface. They're still a little nervous, so watch out for their fireball attacks. It's nothing personal.
entries.target: 现在,地狱的地狱如此暴力,恶魔们终于感到舒服,能够上升到表面.

entries.source: Brachi owns an entire volcano. And he's not too fond of trespassers. One day, when he's finally got the place all to himself, he hopes to make some nice renovations: a third bathroom perhaps.
entries.target: 布拉奇拥有整个火山,他不太喜欢入侵者,有一天,他终于拥有了这个地方,他希望做一些漂亮的翻新:第三间浴室,也许.

entries.source: When these dinosaurs discovered an ancient lost technology, they knew exactly what to do with it: graft it to their bodies! It's time to move beyond this mortal flesh! Buzz saws now!
entries.target: 恐龙发现了一种古老的失落技术,他们知道该怎么用它:将它植入他们的身体! 现在是时候超越这个可死的肉类!

entries.source: They may have lost their natural ability to breathe fire, but natural abilities are a thing of the past! Giant flamethrowers are just better in every way. Tradition can suck these super-heated flames.
entries.target: 它们可能已经失去了自然呼吸火的能力,但自然能力已经过去了!巨型射火器在各方面都更好.传统可以吸收这些超热的火焰.

entries.source: Even glaries have started to dabble in machine augmentation. Losing your sense of self is worth it for the power to fly!
entries.target: 就连格莱里也开始尝试机械改造。为了获得飞行之力，失去自我意识也值得！

entries.source: A more advanced form of the blue glarey. They walk slightly faster. . . so be careful!
entries.target: 蓝色光的形式更先进.它们走得稍快.

entries.source: These glaries have been reinforced with the strongest metals. However, their face remains soft. Perhaps they're hesitant to augment their face, lest they lose who they once were entirely.
entries.target: 它们的光是用最强的金属增强的,但是它们的脸仍然柔软,也许它们犹不决要放大它们的脸,以免它们完全失去原来的样子.

entries.source: Sporting a camouflage pattern, these glaries are sure to sneak up on you--that is, if they could actually move. . . Still, don't underestimate them!
entries.target: 它们会偷偷走到你身边,也就是说,如果它们真的能移动...

entries.source: A gator snapper that has been possessed by one of Xankulos' evil orbs. Its power, and size, have increased dramatically. It now has the ability to fire energy orbs from its mouth.
entries.target: 龙鱼,曾被子魔兽之一所占有.它的力量和大小,已经大大增加.

entries.source: Ambrosia beetles really get a bad rap. They just dig tunnels in trees to plant molds from their fungus pockets and farm it for food. It's not their fault that one of their molds can kill a whole forest!
entries.target: 虫的名声很差,他们只挖道在树木中,从口种下菌,然后为食物种植.

entries.source: Apatapults are generally in charge of keeping the facilities up and running. When the dinos discovered this ancient technology, they worked fast to restore it to its former glory--all in the pursuit of power.
entries.target: 阿帕塔普通常负责维持设施运转。恐龙们发现这项古老技术后，立刻动手将它恢复到昔日辉煌，一切都是为了追求力量。

entries.source: The ogre warriors use dark magic to forge giant axes twice their size. They also use dark magic to prevent themselves from getting tired, despite never sleeping. What can't dark magic do?
entries.target: 狼战士使用黑暗魔法造造就两倍大大的巨斧. 他们还使用黑暗魔法防止自己疲,尽管从来没有睡觉.

entries.source: Bone tacklers peaked in high school. Now they're merely puppets, controlled by anonymous dark magic users. At least they'll always remember that sick touchdown.
entries.target: 骨手在高中达到顶峰,现在他们只是玩偶,由匿名黑魔法用户控制. 至少他们永远会记住那个病人的触击.

entries.source: Wraiths resurrected from dinosaur skulls. They're always in search of a new body. . . Hopefully they don't have an interest in yours!
entries.target: 那些从恐龙头骨中复活的灵魂,他们总是在寻找新尸体.

entries.source: Dark barks are dead trees that refuse to pass on. They still have lingering regrets, such as never getting lovers' names carved into their skin or birds nesting in their limbs. So now they're gonna get ya!
entries.target: 黑色的是死树,拒绝传递,他们仍然抱怨,比如从来没有在皮肤上刻过爱人的名字,

entries.source: Did you know that if enough fungi make connections under the ground they begin to form a mind of their own? Some dark magic might also be required.
entries.target: 你知道吗？当足够多的真菌在地下彼此连接，它们就会逐渐形成自己的意识。当然，可能还需要一点黑魔法。

entries.source: A scarier variation of the green glarey. See, they're orange: a scarier color!
entries.target: 绿色的变化更可怕,看,它们是色,更可怕的颜色!

entries.source: The ghost of a dead hoptung. If you feel something cold and wet at night, it might just be one of these slobbering all over you.
entries.target: 如果你觉得夜间有什么东西冷湿,那可能是你身上的东西.

entries.source: Wraiths resurrected from dinosaur skulls. . . and then placed inside of a painting!
entries.target: 那些从恐龙头骨中复活的灵魂.

entries.source: Considering how weak they are, it's not too surprising to find the ghosts of defeated compies. What's more surprising is when you find them hiding inside of a painting.
entries.target: 考虑到它们是多么弱,发现失败的同伴的鬼魂并不太惊. 更惊的是,你发现它们藏在画中.

entries.source: Was it a pirate, or was it a ninja? Underneath it all, I guess they were always the same.
entries.target: 底下,我猜他们总是相同的.

entries.source: This wasn't the power up you were looking for. . . But maybe it could be, if you can react fast enough!
entries.target: 你想要的力量不是这样,但如果你能反应得足够快,也许会.

entries.source: Hollow dwellers are perhaps the most feared creatures in all of The Dreadlands. Gnomes tell stories of others going missing in the middle of the night, only to find traces of silk where they once slept.
entries.target: 空洞栖居者或许是恐惧之地最令人畏惧的生物。侏儒们常说有人半夜失踪，只在他们原本睡觉的地方留下丝线痕迹。

entries.source: Wizards who follow the fire branch of dark magic. Despite their reluctance to use technology, they still work with the Steely Scavengers out of a common respect for Willow the Wizard.
entries.target: 尽管他们不愿意使用技术,但他们仍然与钢铁挖掘者合作,

entries.source: Wizards who follow the ice branch of dark magic. Their proficiency in ice sculpting came in handy when designing much of Memorial Castle.
entries.target: 那些追随黑暗魔术的冰枝的巫师,他们的冰雕技巧在设计纪念城堡时很有用.

entries.source: Wizards who follow the lightning branch of dark magic. Sometimes the Steely Scavengers will ask them for help in jump starting the more decrepit machinery. Begrudgingly, they oblige.
entries.target: 魔术师们会跟随黑暗魔术的闪电分支,有时钢铁挖掘者会要求他们帮助他们开始跳动更衰退的机器.

entries.source: Equipped with the most advanced augmentations, Stan has numerous ways to take out his prey. What's more, unlike other Steely Scavengers, he was able to regain the ability to breathe fire.
entries.target: 斯坦配备了最先进的强化装置，有多种手段猎杀目标。更厉害的是，他和其他钢铁拾荒者不同，重新获得了喷火能力。

entries.source: Stan doesn't only use the power of augmentation. Power is power, and what's more powerful than dark magic? With the teachings of all three branches, he has pushed himself over the edge.
entries.target: 斯坦不仅使用增强的力量. 力量是力量,还有什么比黑暗魔法更强大?

entries.source: A glarey that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses as well as the ability to fire a cursed blast from its mouth.
entries.target: 现在它拥有更大的防御能力,以及能够从嘴里射出一个诅咒的爆炸.

entries.source: Made in Lord Xankulos' image, these manifestations act as a barrier to prevent you from getting close. But they're not as tough as they seem.
entries.target: 这些表现是为了阻止你接近,但它们并不像看起来那么强硬.

entries.source: A slither that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses as well as the ability to fire multiple cursed fireballs.
entries.target: 被邪恶的赞库洛斯领主诅咒的滑蛇。它防御更强，还能连续发射多枚诅咒火球。

entries.source: A giant glarey that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now moves faster.
entries.target: 巨大的格莱里被邪恶的库洛斯诅咒了.

entries.source: A spotted flingling that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now wields a cursed axe.
entries.target: 子被恶魔古洛斯诅咒,现在它着一个诅咒的斧头.

entries.source: Made from the hearts of those who Lord Xankulos has punished. Is it possible to save them, or will they suffer forever?
entries.target: 由那些受赞库洛斯领主惩罚之人的心脏制成。他们还有可能获救吗，还是会永远受苦？

entries.source: A lotl-cannon that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has the ability to fire cursed energy balls at a more rapid pace.
entries.target: 现在它能够以更快的速度射击诅咒的能量球.

entries.source: A primian that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has the ability to kick faster.
entries.target: 克卢斯的恶魔王诅咒了它,现在它能得更快.

entries.source: A green glarey that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses and can move faster.
entries.target: 绿色的光,被恶魔库洛斯诅咒了,现在它有更大的防御能力,

entries.source: A chain expert that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses and wields a cursed axe.
entries.target: 克卢斯的邪恶爵诅咒了这位链接专家,现在他拥有更大的防御能力,

entries.source: Chuko's back, and he's stronger than ever. He'd never gotten the respect he felt he deserved back at the base, so this change was more than welcome. But is Lord Xankulos' curse too much for him to handle?
entries.target: 朱科回来了,他比以往任何时候都强大,他从来没有得到他应该回来的尊重,所以这个变化是非常欢迎的.

entries.source: Made in Lord Xankulos' image, these manifestations are strong and resolute, acting as the foundations of his stronghold--and his beliefs. But underneath lies a more truthful representation.
entries.target: 按照赞库洛斯领主的形象制成，这些化身坚强而坚定，支撑着他的要塞与信念。但在表象之下，藏着更真实的面貌。

entries.source: Made in Lord Xankulos' image, these manifestations have only one purpose: annihilation. If you encounter one, you're getting too close to where you're not supposed to be.
entries.target: 它们是为了毁灭,如果你遇到它们,你就会走到你不应该到的地方.

entries.source: A cruster thruster that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has the ability to thrust attack faster.
entries.target: 克洛斯的恶魔了,现在它能够更快地推进攻击.

entries.source: A spitfish that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses as well as the ability to fire multiple cursed fireballs.
entries.target: 被邪恶的赞库洛斯领主诅咒的喷射鱼。它防御更强，还能连续发射多枚诅咒火球。

entries.source: A razor rex that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has greater defenses and can throw its blade faster.
entries.target: 雷克斯是被恶魔克鲁斯诅咒的剃须刀,现在它有更大的防御能力,

entries.source: A jelly glarey that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now behaves more aggressively.
entries.target: 一只被邪恶的赞库洛斯领主诅咒的果冻瞪眼怪。如今它的攻击性更强了。

entries.source: A crawler drone that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has the ability to fire multiple cursed energy balls
entries.target: 一架被邪恶的赞库洛斯领主诅咒的爬行无人机。如今它能连续发射多枚诅咒能量球。

entries.source: A pantherasaur that has been cursed by the evil Lord Xankulos. It now has the ability to breathe cursed fire.
entries.target: 鱼被恶魔古洛斯诅咒了,现在它能呼吸诅咒的火.

entries.source: An effigy constructed thousands of years ago in the image of a previous ordained judge. Xankulos now uses it as part of his possessed army.
entries.target: 千年前建成的雕像,以此前被任命的法官的形象.

entries.source: When civility fails, Lord Xankulos finally puts his combat prowess to the test. And what a test it is: Just try and dodge his judgment gavels and vengeful chains.
entries.target: 当文明手段失效时，赞库洛斯领主终于会展现真正的战斗实力。这可是场硬仗：尽力躲开他的审判木槌和复仇锁链吧。

entries.source: Despite Mr. Bear's noble sacrifice, Xankulos was able to maintain most of his power. Unfortunately, a fraction of eternity is still eternity--and that is how long he's determined to reign.
entries.target: 尽管熊先生的高贵牺牲,但库洛斯能够保持他的大部分权力.

entries.source: A lost soul, devoid of purpose or a will to go on. All it can do is rage at the world. But nothing changes.
entries.target: 失去的灵魂,没有目的,没有继续前进的意志.

entries.source: ##                          Welcome to the Fallen Leaf settings save file!                          ##
entries.target: ##欢迎来到"落叶保存文件"设置! ##

entries.source: ##        These are supposed to be changed in-game, so you're not really meant to read this.        ##
entries.target: ## 这些应该在游戏中被改变,所以你不应该读这篇文章. ##

entries.source: ##       But since you're here, you can change most of them if you want, but at your OWN RISK!      ##
entries.target: ## 但既然你在这里,你可以改变他们大多数如果你想,但是在你的风险! ##

entries.source: ##       Editing this file incorrectly could crash your game. If so, try deleting this file.        ##
entries.target: ##错误编辑这个文件可能会导致游戏崩.

entries.source: # Game Resolution: Set to 0 for fullscreen, or 1–4 for 1x–4x windowed.
entries.target: 游戏分辨率:设置为 0 对于全屏幕,或 1–4 对于 1x4x 窗户.

entries.source: # Sound Effects Volume: Set to a decimal between 0 and 1 to set sound effects volume.
entries.target: # 音效音量：设置为0到1之间的小数。

entries.source: # Music Volume: Set to a decimal between 0 and 1 to set music volume.
entries.target: # 音乐音量：设置为0到1之间的小数。

entries.source: # Controller Layout: This isn't used in the game right now, but might be needed to add support for specific controllers one day.
entries.target: #控制器布局:这不是目前在游戏中使用的,但可能需要在某一天增加特定控制器的支持.

entries.source: # Controller Keysets: Set to 0 for Default; 1 for Alternate; or 2 to use custom controller bindings saved below.
entries.target: #控制器键设置:设置为 0 对于默认的情况; 1 替代品;或 2 使用下列保存的定制控制器绑定.

entries.source: # Keyboard Layout: Set to 0 for QWERTY; 1 for QWERTZ; 2 for AZERTY; 3 for Dvorak; 4 for Colemak; or 5 for TNWMLC.
entries.target: 键盘布局:设置为 0 对于QWERTY; 1 对于QWERTZ; 2 对于AZERTY; 3 对于Dvorak; 4 对Colemak;或 5 对于TNWMLC.

entries.source: # Keyboard Keysets: Set to 0 for Default; 1 for WASD; or 2 to use custom keyboard bindings saved below.
entries.target: 键盘键盘设置为 0 对于默认的情况; 1 对于WASD;或 2 使用下面保存的自定义键盘键盘.

entries.source: # Numpad: Set to 0 if not using a numpad for binds, or 1 if using the numpad. This only affects whether or not the numpad shows up visually on the settings menu.
entries.target: 设置到 0 如果不使用带,或 1 如果使用numpad. 这只影响numpad是否在设置菜单中视觉显示.

entries.source: # Custom Controller Binds: This stores the custom binds for the Custom controller keyset. This isn't meant to be edited here, but if you encounter some kind of unrecoverable error you can replace the next 14 lines with -1 to reset the custom binds to undefined.
entries.target: # 定制控制器绑定: 这存储了定制控制器键盘的定制绑定. 这不是为了编辑在这里,但如果你遇到一些无法恢复的错误,你可以更换下一个 14 带有 -1 设置定例绑定为未定义.

entries.source: # Custom Keyboard Binds: This stores the custom binds for the Custom keyboard keyset. This isn't meant to be edited here, but if you encounter some kind of unrecoverable error you can replace the next 14 lines with -1 to reset the custom binds to undefined.
entries.target: # 定制键盘绑定: 这里存储了定制键盘键盘的定制绑定. 这不是为了编辑在这里,但如果你遇到一些无法恢复的错误,你可以更换下一个 14 带有 -1 设置定例绑定为未定义.
